en.name: Baraq
en.title: Ghiyas-ud-din Baraq
en.extract: Baraq (Chagatai and Persian: غیاث الدین براق) was Khan of the Chagatai Khanate (1266–9 August 1271). He was a son of Yesünto'a and a great-grandson of Chagatai Khan. A convert to Islam, he took the name Ghiyas-ud-din.

tr.name: Pohiva Tuʻiʻonetoa
tr.title: Pohiva Tuʻiʻonetoa
tr.extract: Pohiva Tuʻiʻonetoa (30 Haziran 1951 - 19 Mart 2023), Tongalı siyasetçi. Tuʻiʻonetoa, Büyük Okyanus'ta Polinezya ada öbeği içerisinde yer alan Tonga Krallığı'nda 27 Eylül 2019-27 Aralık 2021 tarihleri arası başbakanlık makamında bulunmuştur. Ülkenin başbakanı olarak makamda bulunan ʻAkilisi Pōhiva'nın hayatını kaybetmesi ile birlikte bu görevi geçici olarak başbakan yardımcılığı görevinde bulunan Semisi Sika üstlenmiştir. 27 Eylül 2019 tarihinde parlamentonun Tuʻiʻonetoa'yı başbakan olarak seçmesinden sonra görevi söz konusu tarihte Sika'dan devralarak makama gelmiştir. Kasım 2021 seçimlerinde tekrar meclise seçilerek yeni bir dönem için daha başbakanlığa adaylığını koyacağını ifade etse de, adaylıktan ʻAisake Eke lehine çekilmiştir. Desteklediği Eke'nin mecliste seçimleri rakibi Siaosi Sovaleni'ye kaybetmesi ile başbakanlık görevini Sovaleni'ye devrederek makamdan ayrılmıştır. Tuʻiʻonetoa, bir süredir tıbbî tedavi için bulunduğu Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde 19 Mart 2023'te 71 yaşında hayatını kaybetti.

en.name: Pōhiva Tuʻiʻonetoa
en.description: Prime Minister of Tonga from 2019 to 2021
en.title: Pōhiva Tuʻiʻonetoa
en.extract: Pōhiva Tu’i’onetoa (30 June 1951 – 18 March 2023) was a Tongan accountant and politician who served as the prime minister of Tonga from 2019 to 2021. Tu'i'onetoa succeeded Semisi Sika, who had served as acting prime minister, since the death of ʻAkilisi Pōhiva.

tr.name: Jozef Lenárt
tr.title: Jozef Lenárt
tr.extract: Jozef Lenárt, Slovak siyasetçi. 1963 ila 1968 yılları arasında Çekoslovakya başbakanlığı yapmıştır.

en.name: Jozef Lenárt
en.description: Slovak politician (1923–2004), member of the Czechoslovak Parliament and Slovak National Council
en.title: Jozef Lenárt
en.extract: Jozef Lenárt (3 April 1923 – 11 February 2004) was a Slovak politician who was the prime minister of Czechoslovakia from 1963 to 1968.

en.name: Nouhak Phoumsavanh
en.title: Nouhak Phoumsavanh
en.extract: Nouhak Phoumsavanh or Phoumsavan (Lao: ໜູຮັກ ພູມສະຫວັນ; Thai: หนูฮัก พูมสะหวัน; 9 April 1914– 9 September 2008) was a long time Pathet Lao revolutionary and communist party official who was the 3rd President of Laos, serving from 1992 to 1998.

tr.name: Litokwa Tomeing
tr.title: Litokwa Tomeing
tr.extract: Litokwa Tomeing (14 Ekim 1939 - 12 Ekim 2020), Marshallı siyasetçidir. Tomeing, Büyük Okyanus'ta Mikronezya ada öbeği içerisinde yer alan Marshal Adaları'nda 7 Ocak 2008 - 21 Ekim 2009 tarihleri arasında devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur. Halkların Birleşik Partisi (UPP) üyesi olan Tomeing, 7 Ocak 2008'de mecliste yapılan oylamada 18'e 15 lehte oyla yeni devlet başkanı seçilde ve Kessai Note'nin ardılı olarak makama geldi. Tomeing, görev süresi boyunca iki güvensizlik oyundan sağ çıksa da 21 Ekim 2009'da yapılan başka bir oylamada 15'e karşı 17 oyla güvensizlik alarak oylamayı kaybetti. Meclis başkanı, yeni bir başkan seçilene kadar görevden sorumlu olacak olan Ruben Zackhras'ı halefi olarak atadı.

en.name: Litokwa Tomeing
en.description: Former President of the Marshall Islands (1939-2020)
en.title: Litokwa Tomeing
en.extract: Iroij Litokwa Tomeing (14 October 1939 – 12 October 2020) was the President of the Marshall Islands from January 2008 until October 2009.

en.name: Rodrigo Carazo Odio
en.title: Rodrigo Carazo Odio
en.extract: Rodrigo José Ramón Francisco de Jesús Carazo Odio (27 December 1926 – 9 December 2009) was a Costa Rican economist and politician who served as the 38th President of Costa Rica from 8 May 1978 to 8 May 1982.

en.name: Mario Echandi Jiménez
en.title: Mario Echandi Jiménez
en.extract: Mario José Echandi Jiménez (17 June 1915 – 30 July 2011) was a Costa Rican lawyer and politician who served as the 33rd President of Costa Rica from 1958 to 1962. A conservative liberal, he presided over a process of national reconciliation following the Civil War and modernized the country's drinking water system through the creation of the Costa Rican Institute of Aqueducts and Sewers.

Hoyte, Amerika kıtasının güneyinde, coğrafi açıdan Güney Amerika olarak adlandırılan kısımda yer alan Guyana'da 1984-1985 arasında başbakanlık, 1985-1992 yılları arasında da devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur.

en.name: Desmond Hoyte
en.title: Desmond Hoyte
en.extract: Hugh Desmond Hoyte (9 March 1929 – 22 December 2002) was a Guyanese politician who served as Prime Minister of Guyana from 1984 to 1985 and President of Guyana from 1985 until 1992.

tr.name: Carlyle Glean
tr.title: Carlyle Glean
tr.extract: Sir Carlyle Arnold Glean (d. 11 Şubat 1932 - ö. 21 Aralık 2021), Grenadalı siyasetçi. Glean, Karayipler'de Küçük Antiller'in bir parçası konumunda olan ve coğrafi açıdan Orta Amerika'ya dahil edilen Grenada'da 2008 ile 2013 yılları arasında genel vali olarak görev yaptı. 1990 ile 1995 yılları arasında Nicholas Brathwaite hükûmetinde Milli Eğitim Bakanı olarak görev aldı.

en.name: Carlyle Glean
en.title: Carlyle Glean
en.extract: Sir Carlyle Arnold Glean, (11 February 1932 – 21 December 2021) was a Grenadian politician and educator who served as governor-general of Grenada from 2008 to 2013. A member of the National Democratic Congress, he served in the Senate and was Minister of Education from 1990 to 1995.

en.name: Tiburcio Carías
en.title: Tiburcio Carías Andino
en.extract: Tiburcio Carías Andino (5 March 1876 – 23 December 1969) was a Honduran politician and military officer with the rank of major general. He served as the 38th president of Honduras, briefly in 1924 as constitutional president and later in the form of a dictatorial regime from 1933 until 1949. He was elected president of Honduras in the midst of the Great Depression. He strengthened the Armed Forces, maintained the support of the banana companies by opposing strikes, strongly aligned its government with that of the United States, and kept the country in strict adherence to debt payments.

tr.name: Joseph J. Urusemal
tr.title: Joseph J. Urusemal
tr.extract: Joseph John Urusemal (19 Mart 1952 - 16 Eylül 2025), Mikronezyalı siyasetçi. Urusemal, Büyük Okyanus'ta Mikronezya ada öbeği içerisinde yer alan Mikronezya Federal Devletleri'nde 2003 ile 2007 yılları arasında devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur. Urusemal 11 Mayıs 2003 tarihinde kongre tarafından makama seçilmesinin ardından bu görevi 11. Mayıs 2007 tarihine kadar yürütmüştür. Selefi Leo Falcam, doğrudan yasama meclisi seçimlerinden sonra kongredeki koltuğunu kaybetti. Urusemal'in yerini 2007'de Manny Mori aldı.

en.name: Joseph Urusemal
en.title: Joseph Urusemal
en.extract: Joseph John Urusemal (March 19, 1952 – September 16, 2025) was a Micronesian politician who served as the sixth President of the Federated States of Micronesia from 2003 until 2007.

Dalhousie Üniversitesi'nden Kanunlar Fahri Doktorası ile 1998 yılında onur ödülüne layık görüldü ve 2005 yılında Mount Allison Üniversitesi'nden Fahri Doktora aldı. 25 Mart 2017'de öldü.

en.name: Cuthbert Sebastian
en.title: Cuthbert Sebastian
en.extract: Sir Cuthbert Montraville Sebastian (22 October 1921 – 25 March 2017) was the second governor-general of Saint Kitts and Nevis from 1996 to 2013. He was appointed Governor-General in 1995 and was sworn in on 1 January 1996. While in office, he was the world's oldest serving de facto head of state. His retirement was announced on 25 December 2012 and became effective on 1 January 2013.

Meksika vatandaşı olmuştur. Elemente pankrom veya daha sonra eritronyum adının verilmesini önerdi, ancak keşfi o zamanlar dikkate alınmadı ve isimleri kullanılmadı.

en.name: Andrés Manuel del Río
en.title: Andrés Manuel del Río
en.extract: Andrés Manuel del Río y Fernández (10 November 1764 – 23 March 1849) was a Spanish scientist, naturalist and engineer who discovered compounds of vanadium in 1801. He proposed that the element be given the name panchromium, or later, erythronium, but his discovery was not credited at the time, and his names were not used.

en.name: Cyril V. Jackson
en.title: Cyril Jackson (astronomer)
en.extract: Cyril V. Jackson (5 December 1903 – February 1988) was a South African astronomer, known for discovering 72 asteroids and a number of comets. He was born in Ossett, Yorkshire in England; his father emigrated to South Africa in 1911. He earned his B.Sc. at the University of the Witwatersrand. He worked at Union Observatory in Johannesburg from 1928 to 1947 (IAU code 078, previously known as Transvaal Observatory and later known as Republic Observatory). He served with South African forces in the Second World War, and was mentioned in despatches. After the war he was director of the Yale-Columbia Southern Observatory (YCSO) station in Johannesburg (IAU code 077), which had been established by Yale University in the 1920s. Columbia University subsequently collaborated in that venture and the operation became known as the Yale-Columbia Southern Observatory (YCSO, Inc. was formally created in 1962).

figures.occupationEn: archaeologist, anthropologist, university teacher, art historian

en.name: Spiridon Marinatos
en.title: Spyridon Marinatos
en.extract: Spyridon Marinatos (Greek: Σπυρίδων Μαρινάτος; 17 November [O.S. 4 November] 1901 – 1 October 1974) was a Greek archaeologist who specialised in the Minoan and Mycenaean civilizations of the Aegean Bronze Age. He is best known for the excavation of the Minoan site of Akrotiri on Thera, which he conducted between 1967 and 1974. He received many honours in Greece and abroad, and was considered one of the most important Greek archaeologists of his day. A native of Kephallonia, Marinatos was educated at the University of Athens, the Friedrich Wilhelms University of Berlin, and the University of Halle. His early teachers included noted archaeologists such as Panagiotis Kavvadias, Christos Tsountas and Georg Karo. He joined the Greek Archaeological Service in 1919, and spent much of his early career on the island of Crete, where he excavated several Minoan sites, served as director of the Heraklion Museum, and formulated his theory that the collapse of Neopalatial Minoan society had been the result of the eruption of the volcanic island of Thera around 1600 BCE.

tr.name: Daliah Lavi
tr.title: Daliah Lavi
tr.extract: Daliah Lavi (doğum adı: Daliah Lewinbuk (en İbranice: דליה לביא); 12 Ekim 1942 - 3 Mayıs 2017), İsrailli aktris, şarkıcı ve modeldir. Lavi oyunculuk kariyerinde Vincente Minnelli imzalı 1962 yapımı Two Weeks in Another Town (1962), Mario Bava'nın gotik klasik tarzdaki filmi 1963 yapımı The Whip and the Body (1963) ile bir kadın rolünde yer aldığı Lord Jim ve Matt Helm imzalı 1966 yapımı başrolünü Dean Martin ile paylaştığı The Silencers adlı filmlerde boy göstermiştir. Oyuncunun en aşina rolü ise "The Detainer/007" karakteriyle James Bond serisi filmi 1967 yapımı Casino Royale 'dir. İsrailli şarkıcı ve aktris Daliah Lavi 3 Mayıs 2017'de Asheville, Kuzey Carolina'da 74 yaşında ölmüştür.

en.name: Daliah Lavi
en.title: Daliah Lavi
en.extract: Daliah Lavi (born Daliah Lewinbuk or Levenbuch, Hebrew: דליה לביא [ˌdalja laˈvi]; 12 October 1942 – 3 May 2017) was an Israeli actress, singer, and model.

en.title: Teimuraz II
en.extract: Teimuraz II (Georgian: თეიმურაზ II; 1695 – 8 January 1762) of the Bagrationi dynasty, was a king (mepe) of Kakheti, eastern Georgia, from 1732 to 1744, then of Kartli from 1744 until his death. Teimuraz was also a lyric poet.

en.name: Vakhtang VI of Kartli
en.title: Vakhtang VI
en.extract: Vakhtang VI (Georgian: ვახტანგ VI, 15 September 1675 – 26 March 1737) was a Georgian monarch (mepe) of the royal Bagrationi dynasty. He ruled the East Georgian Kingdom of Kartli as a vassal of Safavid Persia from 1716 to 1724. One of the most important and extraordinary statesmen of early 18th-century Georgia, he is known as a notable legislator, scholar, critic, translator and poet. His reign was eventually terminated by the Ottoman invasion following the disintegration of Safavid Persia, which forced Vakhtang into exile in the Russian Empire. Vakhtang was unable to get the tsar's support for his kingdom and instead had to permanently stay with his northern neighbours for his own safety. On his way to a diplomatic mission sanctioned by Empress Anna, he fell ill and died in southern Russia in 1737, never reaching Georgia.

tr.name: Alexander Bustamante
tr.title: Alexander Bustamante
tr.extract: Sir William Alexander Clarke Bustamante (d. 24 Şubat 1884 - ö. 6 Ağustos 1977), Jamaikalı siyasetçi. Bustamante, Karayipler'de Büyük Antiller'in bir parçası konumunda olan ve coğrafî açıdan Orta Amerika'ya dâhil edilen Jamaika'nın henüz koloni konumundayken başbakanlık görevlerini üstlenen şef başkan olarak makamda bulunmuştur. Makamda bulunduğu süreçte ülkesinin bağımsızlığını elde etmesi ile ülkesinin ilk başbakanı oldu. Ülkesinin henüz Jamaika Kolonisi adı ile Britanya kolonisi olduğu bir süreçte başbakanlık görevlerini yürüten şef bakan olarak 1953 yılında görev almıştır. Bu görevi 1955 yılına kadar sürdürmüştür. Aynı görevi 1962 yılında da üstlenen Bustamante, görevde iken ülke bağımsızlığını elde etmiştir. Jamaika'nın 1962 yılında bağımsızlığını elde etmesinin ardından bağımsız Jamaika'nin ilk başbakan olmuştur. 29 Nisan 1962–22 Şubat 1967 arasında yürüttüğü başbakanlığı kaybedilen seçimlerin ardından ardılı Donald Sangster'e devrederek makamdan ayrılmıştır.

en.name: Alexander Bustamante
en.title: Alexander Bustamante
en.extract: Sir William Alexander Clarke Bustamante (born William Alexander Clarke; 24 February 1884 – 6 August 1977) was a Jamaican politician and leader and founder of the Jamaica Labour Party, who, on Independence Day, August 6, 1962, became the first prime minister of Jamaica.

en.name: Oodgeroo Noonuccal
en.description: Aboriginal Australian poet, artist, teacher and campaigner for Indigenous rights (1920–1993)
en.title: Oodgeroo Noonuccal
en.extract: Oodgeroo Noonuccal ( UUD-gə-roo NOO-nə-kəl; born Kathleen Jean Mary Ruska; 3 November 1920 – 16 September 1993), earlier known as Kath Walker, was an Aboriginal Australian political activist, artist and educator, who campaigned for Aboriginal rights. Noonuccal was best known for her poetry, and was the first Aboriginal Australian to publish a book of verse. Her first book of poetry, We Are Going, was published in 1964.

en.name: René Favaloro
en.title: René Favaloro
en.extract: René Gerónimo Favaloro (July 12, 1923 – July 29, 2000) was an Argentine cardiac surgeon and educator best known for his pioneering work on coronary artery bypass surgery using the great saphenous vein.

tr.name: Žemaitė
tr.title: Žemaitė
tr.extract: Žemaitė (gerçek adı Julija Beniuševičiūtė-Žymantienė, 1845 - 1921), Litvan yazardır. Litvanya'nın en tanınmış yazarlarından biridir. Litvayna Milli Uyanış hareketinin öncülerindendir. 1863 ayaklanmasını desteklemiş; ayaklanmanın aktif katılımcılarından Laurynas Žymantas ile evlenmişti. 20 yıl boyunca Džiuginėnai'de çiftlikte çalışıp çocuklarını büyüttü ve yoksullukla mücadele etti. Yirmi yıl sonra aile Užventis yakınında bir köye yerleşti. Litvan yazar Povilas Višinskis ile tanışıp onun teşviki ile Milli Uyanış hareketine yazılarıyla destek vermeye yöneldi. 1895'ten itibaren yazılar yayımladı. 1912'de Vilnius'a taşınıp çeşitli yayınlarda idari ve editoryal görevler aldı. I. Dünya Savaşı sırasında önce Rusya'ya sonra oğlu Antanas'ın yaşadığı ABD'ye göçtü. Orada Litvan-Amerikan kurumlarında dersler verdi; savaş kurbanları için yardım topladı, yerel basın için yazılar yazdı.1921'de Litvanya'ya döndü ve aynı yıl hayatını kaybetti. En iyi eserlerini 1896-1898 arasında veren yazarın 150 kadar eseri vardır. Litvanya litası üzerinde resmi bulunan tek kadındır.

en.name: Žemaitė
en.title: Žemaitė
en.extract: Žemaitė ([ʒʲɛˈmɐjtʲeː], zh'yeh-MY-tay, "Samogitian woman") was the pen name of Julija Beniuševičiūtė-Žymantienė (4 June [O.S. 23 May] 1845 – 7 December 1921). She was a Lithuanian/Samogitian writer, democrat and lecturer. Born to impoverished gentry, she became one of the major participants in the Lithuanian National Revival. She wrote about peasant life in the style best described as realism.

en.name: Parveen Shakir
en.title: Parveen Shakir
en.extract: Parveen Shakir (24 November 1952 – 26 December 1994) was a Pakistani poet and civil servant of the government of Pakistan. She is best known for her poems, which brought a distinctive feminine voice to Urdu literature. Since her death in a road accident when she was only 42, the "Parveen Shakir Urdu Literature Festival" has been held every year in Islamabad in her memory.

en.name: Mehdi Hassan
en.title: Mehdi Hassan
en.extract: Mehdi Hassan Khan (Urdu: مہدی حسن خاں; 18 July 1927 – 13 June 2012), known as Mehdi Hassan, was a Pakistani ghazal singer and playback singer of great renown. Known as Shahenshah-e-Ghazal (شہنشاہِ غزل, "Emperor of Ghazal"), he is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential figures in the history of ghazal singing. Known for his "haunting" baritone voice, Hassan is credited with bringing ghazal singing to a worldwide audience. He is unique for his melodic patterns and maintaining integrity of the ragas in an innovative way. Born into a family of Kalawant musicians, Hassan was naturally inclined towards music from a young age. He influenced generations of singers from diverse genres, from Jagjit Singh to Parvez Mehdi. He earned numerous awards and accolades during his lifetime and remained a leading singer of Pakistani film industry, along with contemporary playback singer Ahmed Rushdi; it is estimated that Hassan sang for over 300 films during his career.

en.name: Karl-Josef Rauber
en.title: Karl-Josef Rauber
en.extract: Karl-Josef Rauber (11 April 1934 – 26 March 2023) was a German prelate of the Catholic Church who served as an apostolic nuncio from 1982 until his retirement in 2009. He was created a cardinal by Pope Francis in 2015.

en.name: Humberto Maturana
en.title: Humberto Maturana
en.extract: Humberto Maturana Romesín (September 14, 1928 – May 6, 2021) was a Chilean biologist and philosopher. Some name him a second-order cybernetics theoretician alongside the likes of Heinz von Foerster, Gordon Pask, Herbert Brün and Ernst von Glasersfeld. Maturana, along with Francisco Varela and Ricardo B. Uribe, was known for creating the term "autopoiesis" about the self-generating, self-maintaining structure in living systems, and concepts such as structural determinism and structural coupling. His work was influential in many fields, mainly the field of systems thinking and cybernetics. Overall, his work is concerned with the biology of cognition.

figures.occupationTr: senarist, oyuncu, görüntü yönetmeni, Yürütücü yapımcı

tr.name: Patricio Guzmán
tr.title: Patricio Guzmán
tr.extract: Patricio Guzmán Lozanes (11 Ağustos 1941 – 15 Eylül 2026), Şilili belgesel film yönetmeni, senarist ve yapımcı.

en.name: Patricio Guzmán
en.title: Patricio Guzmán
en.extract: Patricio Guzmán Lozanes (August 11, 1941 – September 15, 2026) was a Chilean documentary and feature film director, and screenwriter. He is most known for his film trilogy The Battle of Chile (1975–1979) and more recently for another trilogy; Nostalgia for the Light (2010), The Pearl Button (2015) and The Cordillera of Dreams (2019).

tr.name: Lam Ching Ying
tr.title: Lam Ching Ying
tr.extract: Lam Ching-ying (Çince: 林正英; doğum adı: Lam Gun-bo 林根寶; 27 Aralık 1952 - ö. 8 Kasım 1997), Hong Kong'lu dublör, aktör, film yapımcısı, yönetmen ve aksiyon yönetmeni. Fiziksel olarak yetenekli ve zarif dövüş sanatçısı olan Lam, Mr. Vampire (1985) filminde, acılara katlanan Taocu rahibi oynaması ile biliniyordu. Disiplinli, dikbaşlı, ölçülü ve öz-iradeli olmasıyla bir üne sahipti. Bir aktör, aksiyon koreografı, dövüş sanatçısı ve öğretmeni olarak samimiyet ve uzlaşmaz profesyonelliği ile birçok kişiye dokunmuştur. Tüm dünyada nesiller tarafından saygı görülen kalıcı bir sinematik mirası geride bıraktı.

en.name: Lam Ching-ying
en.title: Lam Ching-ying
en.extract: Lam Ching-ying (Chinese: 林正英; Jyutping: lam4 zing3 jing1; born Lam Gun-bo (林根寶); 27 December 1952 – 8 November 1997) was a Hong Kong stuntman, actor, martial artist and action director. As a practitioner of martial arts Lam starred in a number of notable films that found recognition outside Hong Kong including Encounters of the Spooky Kind, The Prodigal Son, Heroes Shed No Tears, and his best-known role in Mr. Vampire.

en.name: Mykola Shmatko
en.title: Nikolay Shmatko
en.extract: Nikolay Havrylovych Shmatko (Ukrainian: Микола Гаврилович Шматько; 17 August 1943 – 15 September 2020) was a Ukrainian sculptor and painter. He was born in the Donetsk region of Ukraine.

tr.name: Stamen Grigorov
tr.title: Stamen Grigorov
tr.extract: Stamen Gigov Grigorov (Bulgarca: Стамен Гигов Григоров; 27 Ekim 1878 - 27 Ekim 1945) Yoğurt yapımında kullanılan Lactobacillus bulgaricus bakterisini bulması ile ünlü bir Bulgar doktor ve mikrobiyolog. Stamen Grigorov Bulgaristan Prensliği idaresinde, başkent Sofya'nın yaklaşık 90 km güneyindeki Pernik ilinin Trın belediyesine bağlı Studen İzvor köyünde 27 Ekim 1878 tarihine dünyaya geldi. Liseyi Sofya’da bitirdi. Fransa’nın Montpellier şehrinde Doğa Bilimleri, İsviçre’nin Cenevre şehrinde Tıp eğitimini tamamladı. 1905 yılında, 27 yaşındayken en çok bilinen keşfini yaptı. Profesör Léon Massol'un Cenevre'deki mikrobiyoloji laboratuvarında, yoğurdun temelinde belirli bir basil türünün bulunduğunu keşfetti. keşfedilen bu tür, bilim topluluğu tarafından Lactobacillus bulgaricus olarak adlandırıldı. 1950'lerde, devlete ait yoğurt şirketi, "resmi bir Bulgar yoğurdu" üretmek için belirli bakteri suşları karışımının patentini aldı ve tanıttı.

en.name: Stamen Grigorov
en.title: Stamen Grigorov
en.extract: Stamen Gigov Grigorov (Bulgarian: Стамен Гигов Григоров; 27 October 1878 – 27 October 1945) was a prominent Bulgarian physician and microbiologist. He discovered the Lactobacillus bulgaricus bacillus, used in the making of yogurt.

tr.name: Dora Gabe
tr.title: Dora Gabe
tr.extract: Dore Gabe (Bulgarca: Изидора Петрова Габе; 16 Ağustos 1888, Dobriç - 16 Kasım 1983, Sofya) Bulgar Yahudisi şair, çocuk kitapları yazarı, çevirmen ve aktivist. Çocuklar ve yetişkinler için şiir, kısa hikâye, gezi yazı yazmıştır. Şiirleri Bulgaristan'da ders kitabı olarak okutulur. Eserleri pek çok dile çevrilmiştir.

en.name: Dora Gabe
en.title: Dora Gabe
en.extract: Dora Petrova Gabe (in bulgarian: Дора Петрова Габе) (born Isidora Petrova Peysakh, 16 August 1888 – 16 November 1983) was а Bulgarian Jewish poet, writer and translator. She published poetry for adults and children as well as travel books, short stories and essays. In her later years, she also did extensive work in translation. She is widely regarded as one of the most famous Bulgarian poets and is decorated with honors and awards indicating local respect from her home country.

en.name: Ludvík Vaculík
en.description: Czech publicist, politic writer and bookwriter (1926-2015)
en.title: Ludvík Vaculík
en.extract: Ludvík Vaculík [ˈludviːk ˈvatsuˌliːk] (23 July 1926 – 6 June 2015) was a Czech writer and journalist. He was born in Brumov, Moravian Wallachia. A prominent samizdat writer, he was best known as the author of the "Two Thousand Words" manifesto of June 1968.

en.name: Jadranka Stojaković
en.title: Jadranka Stojaković
en.extract: Jadranka Stojaković (Serbian Cyrillic: Јадранка Стојаковић, 24 July 1950 – 3 May 2016) was a Bosnian singer-songwriter popular in the former Yugoslavia, known for her unique voice. Her best known hits are "Sve smo mogli mi", "Što te nema", and "Bistre vode Bosnom teku".

tr.name: Kral Sisowath
tr.title: Sisowath
tr.extract: Sisowath (Kmerce: ព្រះបាទស៊ីសុវតិ្ថ; 7 Eylül 1840 – 9 Ağustos 1927) 1904 yılından öldüğü 1927 yılına kadar Kamboçya kralı. Kral Ang Duong'un oğlu, Prens Si Votha ve Kral Norodom'un üvey kardeşi.

en.name: Sisowath of Cambodia
en.title: Sisowath of Cambodia
en.extract: Sisowath (Khmer: ស៊ីសុវត្ថិ, Sisŏvăt) (7 September 1840 – 9 August 1927) was King of Cambodia from 27 April 1904 to his death in 1927. During his rule, there was extensive French meddling in Cambodian politics, as Cambodia was part of French Indochina. He was the son of King Ang Duong and half brother of Prince Si Votha and King Norodom. He is the progenitor of the House of Sisowath.

figures.occupationEn: actor, singer, stage actor, film director

tr.name: Choi Eun-hee
tr.title: Choi Eun-hee
tr.extract: Choi Eun-hee (Korece: 최은희; 20 Kasım 1926 – 16 Nisan 2018) 1960'lı ve 1970'li yıllarda en popüler Koreli oyunculardan biriydi. 1978'de Choi ve o zamanki eski kocası ve film yönetmeni olan Shin Sang-ok, devlet başkanı Kim Jong Il'un verdiği emirle Kuzey Kore'ye kaçırıldı ve 1986'da Viyana'daki ABD büyükelçiliğine sığınana kadar film çekmeye zorlandılar. Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde on yıl geçirdikten sonra 1999'da Güney Kore'ye geri döndüler. Eski CIA ajanı Michael Lee'nin verdiği bilɡiye göre, Choi ve Shin 1989'da (kaçışlarından üç yıl sonra) Amerikan vatandaşı oldular ve sırasıyla Theresa Sheen ve Simon Sheen isimlerini aldılar. 1999'da Güney Kore'ye dönmeden önce Virginia, Reston'da, ardından Kaliforniya, Beverly Hills'te yaşadılar. 16 Nisan 2018'de Choi, öğleden sonra böbrek diyalizi geçirmesi gereken bir hastanede 91 yaşında öldü. Ölümü üzerine Güney Kore genelinde yas tutuldu.

en.name: Choi Eun-hee
en.title: Choi Eun-hee
en.extract: Choi Eun-hee (Korean: 최은희; November 20, 1926 – April 16, 2018) was a South Korean actress. She was one of South Korea's most popular stars of the 1960s and 1970s. In 1978, Choi and her then ex-husband, movie director Shin Sang-ok, were abducted to North Korea, where they were forced to make films until they sought asylum at the United States embassy in Vienna in 1986. They returned to South Korea in 1999 after spending a decade in the United States.

tr.name: Mare Vint
tr.title: Mare Vint
tr.extract: Mare Vint (doğum adı Mare Mänd, 15 Eylül 1942-10 Mayıs 2020), Eston bir grafik sanatçısıdır. Çalışmalarında genellikle "ideal bir manzara" göstermiştir.

en.name: Mare Vint
en.title: Mare Vint
en.extract: Mare Vint (born Mare Mänd; 15 September 1942 – 10 May 2020) was an Estonian graphic artist. In her work, Vint mostly depicted an "ideal landscape".

tr.name: Miliza Korjus
tr.title: Miliza Korjus
tr.extract: Miliza Elizabeth Korjus [militsa] (18 Ağustos 1909 - 26 Ağustos 1980), Polonya doğumlu etnik Estonyalı koloratur soprano opera sanatçısı ve daha sonra Hollywood filmlerinde rol aldı. Doğum yılı belirsiz olarak bildirilmiştir ve çeşitli kaynaklara göre 1900 ile 1909 arasında değişmektedir. Kızı Melissa Wells, yılın 1909 olduğunu ve annesinin bunu bildiğini iddia ediyor. Daha sonra vatandaşlık almış ve ABD vatandaşı olmuştur. The Great Waltz'daki performansıyla 1938'de En İyi Yardımcı Kadın Oyuncu Akademi Ödülü'ne aday gösterildi.

en.name: Miliza Korjus
en.title: Miliza Korjus
en.extract: Miliza Korjus (August 18, 1909 – August 26, 1980) was a Polish-Estonian lyric coloratura soprano opera singer who appeared in classical American and Mexican sound films during the Golden Age of Hollywood. Korjus became a naturalized United States citizen in her adulthood. She was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress in 1939 for her performance in The Great Waltz.

en.name: Álvaro Holden Roberto
en.title: Holden Roberto
en.extract: Álvaro Holden Necaca Roberto Diasiwa (Angolan Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈal.va.ɾu ˈolden ɾoˈbeʁtu]; 12 January 1923 – 2 August 2007) was an Angolan politician who founded and led the National Liberation Front of Angola (FNLA) from 1962 to 1999.

tr.name: Teymur bin Faysal
tr.title: Teymur bin Faysal
tr.extract: Teymur bin Faysal bin Turki (Arapça: تيمور بن فيصل بن تركي; d. 1886, Maskat - 28 Ocak 1965, Bombay), Umman'ın 1913-1932 yılları arasındaki sultanı.

en.name: Taimur bin Faisal Al Said
en.title: Taimur bin Feisal
en.extract: Sultan Taimur bin Faisal bin Turki Al Said (Arabic: تيمور بن فيصل بن تركي; 1886 – 28 January 1965) was the Sultan of Muscat and Oman from 5 October 1913 to 10 February 1932.

tr.name: Abdurrahman Suar el-Dahab
tr.title: Abdurrahman Suar el-Dahab
tr.extract: Mareşal Abdurrahman Suar el-Dahab (1934 - 18 Ekim 2018) (Arapça: عبد الرحمن سوار الذهب), 6 Nisan 1985'ten 6 Mayıs 1986'ya kadar Sudan Devlet Başkanıydı. Tam adı Sudan Savunma Bakanlığı tarafından Abdurrahman Muhammed Hasan Suar el-Dahab olarak da listelenmiştir.

en.name: Abdel Rahman Swar al-Dahab
aliases: Abd ar Rahman Siwar adh Dhahab
en.title: Abdel Rahman Swar al-Dahab
en.extract: Abdel Rahman Suwar al-Dahab (otherwise known as Suwar al-Dahab or al-Dahab; 1 January 1934 – 18 October 2018) (Arabic: عبد الرحمن سوار الذهب) was a Sudanese military officer who served as the Head of State of Sudan from 6 April 1985, to 6 May 1986. His full name has also been listed by the Sudanese Ministry of Defence as Abdul Rahman Muhammad Hassan Swar Al Thahab.

en.name: Nicholas Georgescu-Roegen
en.title: Nicholas Georgescu-Roegen
en.extract: Nicholas Georgescu-Roegen (born Nicolae Georgescu, 4 February 1906 – 30 October 1994) was a Romanian mathematician, statistician and economist. He is best known today for his 1971 magnum opus The Entropy Law and the Economic Process, in which he argued that all natural resources are irreversibly degraded when put to use in economic activity. A progenitor and a paradigm founder in economics, Georgescu-Roegen's work was decisive for the establishing of ecological economics as an independent academic sub-discipline in economics. In the history of economic thought, Georgescu-Roegen was the first economist of some standing to theorise on the premise that all of earth's mineral resources will eventually be exhausted at some indeterminate future point.

tr.name: Anneke Grönloh
tr.title: Anneke Grönloh
tr.extract: Anneke Grönloh (d. 7 Haziran 1942, Tondano - ö. 14 Eylül 2018, Arleuf, Nièvre, Fransa), Hollandalı şarkıcı. 1964 Eurovision Şarkı Yarışması'nda ülkesi Hollanda'yı "Jij bent mijn leven" adlı şarkıyla temsil etmiş, yarışmada 10. olmuştur. Sanatçı 14 Eylül 2018'de 76 yaşında ölmüştür.

en.name: Anneke Grönloh
en.title: Anneke Grönloh
en.extract: Johanna Louise "Anneke" Grönloh (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɑnəkə ˈɡrʏnloː]; 7 June 1942 – 14 September 2018) was a Dutch singer. She had a successful career starting in 1959 that lasted throughout the 1960s, and scored a hit with "Brandend Zand", one of the best-selling Dutch songs of all time.

en.name: Chrisye
en.title: Chrisye
en.extract: Hajji Chrismansyah Rahadi ([krisˈmanʃah raˈhadi]; born Christian Rahadi [kristiˈan raˈhadi]; 16 September 1949 – 30 March 2007), better known by his stage name Chrisye ([krisˈjə]), was an Indonesian progressive pop singer and songwriter. Born in Jakarta of mixed Chinese-Indonesian descent, Chrisye became interested in music at an early age. At high school, he played bass guitar in a band he formed with his brother, Joris. In the late 1960s, he joined Sabda Nada (later Gipsy), a band led by his neighbours, the Nasutions. In 1973, after a short hiatus, he rejoined the band to play in New York for a year. He briefly returned to Indonesia and then went back to New York with another band, the Pro's. After once again returning to Indonesia, he collaborated with Gipsy and Guruh Sukarnoputra to record the 1976 indie album Guruh Gipsy. Following the success of Guruh Gipsy; in 1977, Chrisye recorded two of his most critically acclaimed works: "Lilin-Lilin Kecil" by James F. Sundah, which eventually became his signature song, and the soundtrack album Badai Pasti Berlalu.

tr.name: Lynden Pindling
tr.title: Lynden Pindling
tr.extract: Lynden Oscar Pindling (22 Mart 1930, Nassau - 26 Ağustos 2000, Nassau), Bahamalı siyasetçidir. Pindling, Karayipler'de yer alan ve coğrafi açıdan Orta Amerika'ya dahil edilen Bahamalar'ın bağımsızlık sonrası ilk başbakanı olarak 1973 ile 1992 yılları arasında başbakanlık makamında bulunmuştur. Ülkenin ilk siyahi başbakanı olarak bu göreve gelen ve Bahamalar'da Bahama ulusunun atası olarak görülen Pindling, ülkesinin henüz Büyük Britanya'ya bağlı koloni bölgesi konumundayken 1967 ile 1973 yılları arasında da başbakanlık makamında bulunmuştur. 1992 yılında başbakanlık makamını kaybettikten sonra muhalefet lideri olarak mecliste yer alan Pindling, 1997 seçimlerinden sonra yaşadığı sağlık sorunları nedeniyle siyasete veda etmiştir. Pindling 26 Ağustos 2000 tarihinde ölmüştür. 2006 yılında Nassau'da bulunan uluslararası havalimanına adı verilerek Lynden Pindling Uluslararası Havalimanı olarak adlandırılmıştır.

en.name: Lynden Pindling
en.title: Lynden Pindling
en.extract: Sir Lynden Oscar Pindling, (22 March 1930 – 26 August 2000) was a Bahamian politician who was the first prime minister of the Bahamas from 1973 to 1992. Pindling is regarded by some as the "Father of the Nation", having led the Bahamas to majority rule and independence. Pindling served as the first black colonial premier of the Bahamas from 1967 to 1969, being the second and final officeholder. He was leader of the Progressive Liberal Party (PLP) from 1956 to 1997 when he resigned from public life under scandal. Pindling won an unbroken string of general elections until 1992, when the PLP lost to the Free National Movement (FNM) led by Hubert Alexander Ingraham. He conceded defeat with the words: "the people of this great little democracy have spoken in a most dignified and eloquent manner and the voice of the people, is the voice of God".

en.name: Cyprian Ekwensi
en.title: Cyprian Ekwensi
en.extract: Chief Cyprian Odiatu Duaka Ekwensi (26 September 1921 – 4 November 2007) was a Nigerian author of novels, short stories, and children's books.

tr.name: Zuleykha Seyidmammadova
tr.title: Züleyha Seyidmemmedova
tr.extract: Züleyha Seyidmemmedova (Azerice: Züleyxa Seyidməmmədova; 22 Mart 1919 - 1999), Azerbaycanlı Sovyet pilottur. Leyla Memmedbeyova ile birlikte ilk Azerbaycanlı kadın savaş pilotlarından birisidir. Seyidmemmedova 22 Mart 1919 tarihinde Bakü'de doğmuştur. 1935 yılında pilot lisansını memleketindeki bir uçuş okulunda alan Seyidmemmedova, eğitimine Moskova yakınlarındaki Zhurkovsky'deki havacılık akademisinde devam etti. 122. Hava Grubunda savaş pilotu olarak görev yapmıştır. 1999 yılında memleketi Bakü'de ölmüştür.

en.name: Zuleykha Seyidmammadova
en.title: Zuleykha Seyidmammadova
en.extract: Zuleykha Seyidmammadova (Azerbaijani: Züleyxa Mirhəbib qızı Seyidməmmədova, Russian: Зулейха Мир-Габиб кызы Сеидмамедова; 22 March 1919 – 10 November 1994) was one of the first Azerbaijani female pilots, and the first Azerbaijani woman to fly in combat. She gained her pilot's license in 1935 at a flying club in her hometown, and later at the aviation academy in Zhukovsky near Moscow. In 1938 she became qualified as a petrochemical engineer but chose to pursue aviation as her main career. During World War II, she was the regimental navigator of the 586th Fighter Aviation Regiment, one of the three women's military aviation regiments founded by Marina Raskova. During the war, she fought in over 40 aerial battles and carried out over 500 missions. During the war, she would inform the commissar as well as Tamara Kazarinova, the commander of her regiment, about the pilots' attitudes toward their leadership. After the war, she was demobilized and in 1952 she became the Minister of Social Security of the Azerbaijan SSR. Seyidmammadova died in Baku in 1994.

en.name: Juan Montalvo
en.title: Juan Montalvo
en.extract: Juan María Montalvo Fiallos (13 April 1832 - 17 January 1889) was an Ecuadorian essayist and novelist. His writing was strongly marked by anti-clericalism and opposition to presidents Gabriel García Moreno and Ignacio de Veintemilla. He was the publisher of the magazine El Cosmopolita. One of his best-known books is Las Catilinarias, published in 1880. His essays include Siete tratados (1882) and Geometría Moral (posthumous, 1902). He also wrote a sequel to Don Quixote de la Mancha, called Capítulos que se le olvidaron a Cervantes. He was admired by writers, essayists, intellectuals such as Jorge Luis Borges and Miguel de Unamuno. He died in Paris in 1889. His body was embalmed and is exhibited in a mausoleum in his hometown of Ambato.

tr.name: VIII. Muhammed el Amin
tr.title: VIII. Muhammed el-Emin
tr.extract: VIII. Muhammed el Amin veya bilinen adıyla Lamine Bey, 4 Eylül 1881 tarihinde Kartaca'da doğmuştur. VI. Muhammed el Habib ile Lalla Fatıma'nın oğlu olup, Hüseyni Hanedanı'na mensuptur. 1943'ten 1956'ya kadar Tunus Beyi (Fransız Tunusu) olmuş, 1956'dan 1957'ye kadar Tunus Kralı olarak saltanatını sürdürmüştür. Cumhuriyet döneminde 30 Eylül 1962'ye kadar Prenslik yapmıştır. VIII. Muhammed el Amin, VII. Muhammed el Münsif'in iadesi için müdavimlerinden gelen talepler karşısınıda sessiz kaldı. Nadir görünüşleri, tebaasının ona karşı kayıtsız ya da gerçekten düşman olduğunu gösteriyordu. Durumunu yeniden inşa etmek için, Aralık 1943'te grev yapan Ez-Zitouna Üniversitesi öğretmenlerini destekledi. Ancak genel düşünce, onun tahtından feragat edip tacı VII. Muhammed el Münsif'e geri vermek istediği yönündeydi. Bu söylentiler yalanlanınca popülerliği yeniden düştü. 7 Mayıs 1944'te Charles de Gaulle, Tunus'un Mihver Devletleri'nden kurtuluşunun 1. yıldönümünde Tunus'u ziyaret etti. Tunuslular, onun VII. Muhammed el Münsif'i geri getireceğini umdular, ancak bu olmadı.

en.name: Muhammad VIII of Tunisia
en.title: Lamine Bey
en.extract: Muhammad el-Amine Bey bin Muhammad el-Habib (Arabic: محمد الأمين باي بن محمد الحبيب, romanized: Muḥammad al-Amīn Bāy bin Muḥammad al-Ḥabīb; 4 September 1881 – 30 September 1962), commonly known as Lamine Bey, was the last Bey of Tunis (15 May 1943 – 20 March 1956), and also the only King of Tunisia after independence. Lamine Bey was enthroned in unusual circumstances following the removal of his predecessor Moncef Bey by the French Resident General Henri Giraud in 1943. It was not until Moncef Bey's death in 1948 that Lamine Bey's legitimacy was recognized by the people of Tunisia. He took steps to align himself with the Tunisian national movement against the French protectorate but was sidelined by the Neo Destour after he accepted French-initiated reforms in 1954. Shortly after independence, Lamine Bey was turned out of his palace along with his family. Their property was seized and several family members were imprisoned. He ended his days living in a small apartment in Tunis.

en.name: Khady Sylla
en.title: Khady Sylla
en.extract: Khady Sylla (Dakar, March 27, 1963 – Dakar, October 8, 2013) was a Senegalese writer of two novels, short work, and filmmaker.

en.name: Fe del Mundo
aliases: Fé Primitiva del Mundo y Villanueva
en.title: Fe del Mundo
en.extract: Fe Villanueva del Mundo (born Fé Primitiva del Mundo y Villanueva; November 27, 1911 – August 6, 2011) was a Filipino pediatrician. She founded the first pediatric hospital in the Philippines and helped shape the country's modern child healthcare system. Her pioneering work in pediatrics in the Philippines spanned eight decades. She gained international recognition, including the Ramon Magsaysay Award for Public Service in 1977. In 1980, she was conferred the rank and title of National Scientist of the Philippines, and in 2010, she received the Order of Lakandula. She was the first female president of the Philippine Pediatric Society and the first woman to be named National Scientist of the Philippines. She was also the first Asian to be elected president of the Philippine Medical Association in its 65-year history, and the first Asian to be voted president of the Medical Women's International Association.

en.name: Nora Aunor
en.title: Nora Aunor
en.extract: Nora Cabaltera Villamayor (May 21, 1953 – April 16, 2025), known professionally as Nora Aunor, was a Filipino actress, producer, and singer. Known for her leading roles with patriotic, feminist and socio-political themes, she appeared in more than 170 motion pictures during a career that spanned over five decades. Regarded as the most awarded Filipino actress in history, she was known as the Philippines' "Superstar" and was conferred as a National Artist of the Philippines for Film and Broadcast Arts in 2022. Aunor started her career as a singer, after winning a local talent search. She rose to fame in the following years as both a singer and actress. After her film debut in All Over the World (1967), she transitioned into drama, with highly acclaimed performances in films such as Tatlong Taong Walang Diyos (Three Years Without God) (1976), Minsa'y Isang Gamu-gamo (Once a Moth) (1976), Ina Ka ng Anak Mo (You Are Your Daughter's Mother) (1979), Himala (Miracle) (1982), Bulaklak sa City Jail (Flowers of the City Jail) (1984), and Bona (1980).

tr.name: Hayko
tr.title: Hayko (1973 doğumlu şarkıcı)
tr.extract: Hayk Hakobyan ya da bilinen adıyla Hayko (Ermeni: Հայկ Հակոբյան, 25 Ağustos 1973, Erivan - 29 Eylül 2021, Erivan), Ermeni şarkıcı, söz yazarı ve bestecidir. 2007 Eurovision Şarkı Yarışması'nda Ermenistan'ı "Anytime You Need" adlı şarkıyla temsil ederek sekizinci olmuştur. Hayko, 29 Eylül 2021'de COVID-19 nedeniyle doğum yeri Erivan, Ermenistan'da 48 yaşında öldü.

en.name: Hayko
en.title: Hayko
en.extract: Hayk Borisi "Hayko" Hakobyan (Armenian: Հայկ Բորիսի "Հայկո" Հակոբյան; 25 August 1973 – 29 September 2021) was an Armenian singer and songwriter.

en.name: Robert Abajyan
en.description: Armenian military person, Hero of Artsakh
en.title: Robert Abajyan
en.extract: Robert Abajyan (Armenian: Ռոբերտ Աբաջյան; 16 November 1996 – 2 April 2016) was an Armenian junior sergeant in the Republic of Artsakh Defense Army. He was posthumously awarded the "Hero of Artsakh" which is the highest honorary title of the self-declared Republic of Artsakh. Abajyan fought alone for several hours against special forces groups of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces during the Armenian–Azerbaijani clashes of 2016 in the northeast line of contact on the night of 1–2 April. He gestured as if to surrender, and then pulled out a grenade and blew up the approaching Azerbaijani soldiers with himself.

tr.name: Mindon Min
tr.title: Mindon Min
tr.extract: Mindon Min (1808 – 1878), doğum ismi Maung Lwin, 1853'ten 1878'e kadar Burma'nın (Myanmar) sondan bir önceki kralıydı Burma'nın en popüler ve saygı duyulan krallarından biriydi. Üvey kardeşi Kral Pagan yönetiminde 1852'deki İkinci İngiliz-Birmanya Savaşı, Aşağı Burma'nın Britanya İmparatorluğu tarafından ilhak edilmesiyle sona erdi. Mindon ve küçük kardeşi Kanaung üvey kardeşleri Kral Pagan'ı devirdiler. Saltanatının büyük kısmını ülkesinin üst kesimlerini İngiliz saldırılarından korumaya ve krallığını modernize etmeye çalışarak geçirdi.

en.name: Mindon Min
aliases: King of Burma Siri Pavara Vizara Nanda Yasapandita Mahadhammarajatiraja
en.title: Mindon Min
en.extract: Mindon Min (Burmese: မင်းတုန်းမင်း, pronounced [mɪ́ɰ̃dóʊɰ̃ mɪ́ɰ̃]; 1808 – 1878), born Maung Lwin, was the penultimate king of Burma (Myanmar) from 1853 to 1878. He was one of the most popular and revered kings of Burma because of his role in the Fifth Buddhist Council. Under his half brother King Pagan, the Second Anglo-Burmese War in 1852 ended with the annexation of Lower Burma by the British Empire. Mindon and his younger brother Kanaung overthrew their half brother King Pagan. He spent most of his reign trying to defend the upper part of his country from British encroachments, and to modernize his kingdom.

en.name: Predrag Matvejević
en.title: Predrag Matvejević
en.extract: Predrag Matvejević (7 October 1932 – 2 February 2017) was a Bosnian and Croatian writer and scholar. A literature scholar who taught at universities in Zagreb, Paris and Rome, he is best known for his 1987 non-fiction book Mediterranean: A Cultural Landscape, a seminal work of cultural history of the Mediterranean region which has been translated into more than 20 languages.

en.name: Abel Muzorewa
en.description: First and only prime minister of Zimbabwe Rhodesia (1979-80)
en.title: Abel Muzorewa
en.extract: Abel Tendekayi Muzorewa (14 April 1925 – 8 April 2010), also commonly referred to as Bishop Muzorewa, was a Zimbabwean bishop and politician who served as the first and only Prime Minister of Zimbabwe Rhodesia from the Internal Settlement to the Lancaster House Agreement in 1979. A United Methodist Church bishop and nationalist leader, he held office for less than a year.

tr.name: Vaçe Zela
tr.title: Vaçe Zela
tr.extract: Vaçe Zela (7 Nisan 1939 Loşna – 6 Şubat 2014 Basel) Arnavut şarkıcı. Arnavutluk'ta komünist rejim döneminin tanınmış bir şarkıcısıdır. 1962 yılında Radyo Televizyon Kurumu tarafından düzenlenen ilk Arnavutluk Şarkı Festivali'nde birinci olmuş, daha sonra on bir defa daha bu ödüle layık görülmüştür. 1973 yılında Arnavutluk Liyakatli Sanatçısı ödülünü, 1977 yılında ise Arnavutluk Halkın Sanatçısı ödülünü kazanmıştır. 24 Aralık 2002 tarihinde Arnavutluk Devlet Başkanı Alfred Moisiu tarafından Ulusal Onur Nişanı ile ödüllendirilmiştir. 2014 yılında İsviçre'de ölmüştür.

en.name: Vaçe Zela
en.title: Vaçe Zela
en.extract: Vaçe Zela (Albanian pronunciation: [ˈvatʃɛ ˈzɛla]; 7 April 1939 – 6 February 2014) was an Albanian singer and songwriter. She was a leading figure in Albania's music industry and is considered one of the most influential musicians of the 20th century. Born in Lushnjë and raised in Tirana within Communist Albania, she developed a great interest in music at an early age before embarking on a professional career as a musician in 1962. An eleven-time winner of Festivali i Këngës, she began building her reputation as a highly successful musician by winning the first edition, and went on to win another ten editions of Festivali i Kenges. Zela is a recipient of significant awards and decorations. She was awarded the Merited Artist Order, People's Artist Order and Honor of Nation Order.

tr.name: Tefta Taşko-Koço
tr.title: Tefta Tashko-Koço
tr.extract: Tefta Tashko-Koço (2 Kasım 1910; 22 Aralık 1947) Arnavut şarkıcı ve soprano. Bölgesel müzik endüstrisinde önde gelen ve 20. yüzyılın Arnavutça konuşan dünyasında en etkili kişiliklerden biri olarak kabul edildi. Ölümünden sonra Arnavutluk Halk Sanatçısı unvanını aldı.

en.name: Tefta Tashko-Koço
en.title: Tefta Tashko-Koço
en.extract: Tefta Tashko-Koço (pronounced [ˈtɛfta ˈtaʃkɔ ˈkɔt͡ʃɔ]; 2 November 1910 – 22 December 1947) was an Albanian singer and soprano. She was a leading figure in the regional music industry and is considered one of the most influential personalities of the 20th century in the Albanian-speaking world. She was posthumously awarded the prestigious title People's Artist.

tr.name: Antonio Guzmán Fernández
tr.title: Antonio Guzmán Fernández
tr.extract: Silvestre Antonio Guzmán Fernández (12 Şubat 1911 - 4 Temmuz 1982), Dominikli iş insanı ve siyasetçi, Mayıs 1978 - Temmuz 1982 arasında Dominik Cumhuriyeti'nin devlet başkanı. Daha 15 yaşında ailesinin dokuma mağazalarında çalışmaya başladı. On yedi yaşına geldiğinde Curaçao Ticaret Şirketi'nin mağazalarını yönetiyordu. Toprağa yatırım yaparak pirinç yetiştirmeye başladı. Kısa bir süre sonra öteki tarımsal ihraç ürünlerine de el attı. 1940'ta hayvan çiftlikleriyle de büyük servet edinmişti. Diktatör Rafael Trujillo öldükten sonra (1961) sonra Guzman merkez sol eğilimli Dominik Devrimci Partisi'ne (Partido Revolucionario Dominicano - PRD) girdi. Aralık 1962'de PRD'nin kurucusu Juan Bosch seçimi kazanınca tarım bakanlığına getirildi. Eylül 1963'te Bosch iktidardan düşürülünceye değin bu görevde kaldı. 1966'da başkan adayı Juan Bosch'un yanında başkan yardımcılığına aday olduysa da kazanamadı. PRD sonraki seçimleri boykot etti. 1978 seçimlerine gelindiğinde PRD ile Bosch'un yolları ayrılmak üzereydi.

en.name: Antonio Guzmán Fernández
en.title: Antonio Guzmán Fernández
en.extract: Sylvestre Antonio Guzmán Fernández (12 February 1911 – 4 July 1982), best known as Antonio Guzmán, was a Dominican businessman and politician who served as the 46th president of the Dominican Republic from 1978 until his death in 1982. In 1978, Guzmán ran in the general elections against strongman Joaquín Balaguer, who at the time had ruled the country for 12 years and during that period, repressed, jailed, and killed political opponents. The military stopped counting after the polls showed an unmistakable favour of Guzmán, but then resumed after protests at home and pressure internationally, and Guzmán won. During his presidency, the country turned in a more democratic direction and was characterized by a strong respect for civil liberties, a condition practically nonexistent in Dominican history in the 20th century. Guzmán helped author the Dominican democratic consecration, when the alternation of political parties in the State was verified for the first time through elections. On 4 July 1982, Guzmán committed suicide.

en.name: Theresa Kachindamoto
en.title: Theresa Kachindamoto
en.extract: Theresa Kachindamoto (23 November 1958 – 13 August 2025) was a Malawian paramount chief and activist. Primarily active in the Dedza District in central Malawi, she had informal authority over more than 900,000 people. She was known for her forceful action in dissolving child marriages and advocacy on education for both girls and boys. Over 3,500 marriages were annulled.

en.name: Eusebio Ayala
en.title: Eusebio Ayala
en.extract: Eusebio Ayala Bordenave (August 14, 1875 – June 4, 1942) was a Paraguayan politician who served as the 28th President of Paraguay from 7 November 1921 to 12 April 1923 and again from 15 August 1932 to 17 February 1936. A member of the Liberal Party, Ayala led Paraguay through the Chaco War (1932–1935), which resulted in an upset victory against Bolivia, securing Paraguayan control over large parts of the disputed Gran Chaco region. In February 1936, however, Ayala was overthrown by Colonel Rafael Franco. He and General José Félix Estigarribia were jailed and sent into exile.

en.name: Sony Lab'ou Tansi
en.title: Sony Lab'ou Tansi
en.extract: Sony Lab'ou Tansi (5 July 1947 – 14 June 1995), born Marcel Ntsoni, was a Congolese novelist, short-story writer, playwright, and poet in French language. Though he was only 47 when he died, Tansi remains one of the most prolific African writers and the most internationally renowned practitioner of the "New African Writing." His novel The Antipeople won the Grand Prix Littéraire d'Afrique Noire. In his later years, he ran a theatrical company in Brazzaville in the Republic of the Congo.

en.name: Laurent Monsengwo Pasinya
en.title: Laurent Monsengwo Pasinya
en.extract: Laurent Monsengwo Pasinya (7 October 1939 – 11 July 2021) was a Congolese prelate of the Catholic Church. He was the Archbishop of Kinshasa from 2007 to 2018. He became a cardinal in 2010. He was widely recognized as a champion of peace, dialogue, and human rights.

en.name: Đuro Daničić
en.title: Đuro Daničić
en.extract: Đuro Daničić (Serbian Cyrillic: Ђуро Даничић, pronounced [dʑǔːro dǎnit͡ʃit͡ɕ]; 4 April 1825 – 17 November 1882), born Đorđe Popović (Serbian Cyrillic: Ђорђе Поповић) and also known as Đura Daničić (Serbian Cyrillic: Ђура Даничић), was a Serbian philologist, translator, linguistic historian and lexicographer. He made significant contributions towards the establishment of the modern standard Serbo-Croatian language on the basis of the works of Vuk Karadžić.

tr.name: Sanja Ilić
tr.title: Sanja Ilić
tr.extract: Aleksandar "Sanja" Ilić (Sırp Kiril:Александар Сања Илић}}; d. 27 Mart 1951 – ö.7 Mart 2021) Sırp şarkıcı ve şarkı-yazarı. 1998 yılında Balkanika müzik grubunu kurmuştur. Müzik grubu ile birlikte 2018 Eurovision Şarkı Yarışması'nda Sırbistan'ı "Nova deca" adlı şarkıyla temsil etmiştir. 1971 ve 1975 yıllarında aktif olan San Yugoslav müzik grubunun da kurucusudur.

en.name: Sanja Ilic
en.title: Sanja Ilić
en.extract: Aleksandar "Sanja" Ilić (Serbian Cyrillic: Александар "Сања" Илић; 27 March 1951 – 7 March 2021) was a Serbian and Yugoslav musician and composer. Ilić started composing as a teenager. In 1971 he formed the rock band San, which disbanded in 1975, after the band's vocalist Predrag Jovičić died in concert from an electric shock. After San split up, Ilić continued his career as a composer, authoring several hit songs for Yugoslav pop and rock artists. He collaborated with composer and keyboardist Sloba Marković on the electronic music album Delta Project and with actor and lyricist Irfan Mensur on the album Plava ptica. In 2000, Ilić formed the ethnic music ensemble Balkanika, with which he recorded five albums and had numerous performances across the world. During his career, Ilić wrote music for theatre, film, television shows and various performers. He died in 2021 in Belgrade. He was the brother of rock musician and composer Dragoljub Ilić and husband of actress Zlata Petković.

tr.name: Louis Lansana Beavogui
tr.title: Louis Lansana Beavogui
tr.extract: Louis Lansana Beavogui (28 Aralık 1923 - 19 Ağustos 1984), Gineli doktor ve siyasetçi. Beavogui, Afrika ülkesi Gine'de 1972 ile 1984 yılları arasında başbakanlık makamında ve 1984 yılında da kısa bir süre geçici olarak devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur. Gine'de ilk ve orta öğrenimini tamamladıktan sonra lisans eğitimi için Senegal'e giden Beavogui, burada tıp üzerine eğitim almıştır. Eğitim süresinin ardından yeniden Gine'ye geri dönen Beavogui, Kissidougou ve Guekedou'da doktor olarak görev almıştır. Siyasi hayatına Gine Demokrat Parti - Afrika Demokratik Hareketi içerisinde parti sekreteri olarak başlayan Beavogui, ilerleyen süreçte Kissidougou'ya belediye başkanı olmuştur. Ülkesi Gine'nin 28 Eylül 1958 tarihinde gerçekleştirilen referandumda Fransa'ya bağlı bir bölge olarak kalmak istememesi sonucu tek taraflı olarak ilan ettiği bağımsızlığın ardından oluşturulan hükûmette Ekonomi ve Planlama Bakanı olarak yer almıştır. Ülkenin bağımsızlığının ardından basılan paralarda kendisinin imzası yer almıştır.

en.name: Louis Lansana Beavogui
en.title: Louis Lansana Beavogui
en.extract: Louis Lansana Beavogui (N'Ko: ߟߊ߲߭ߛߌ߬ߣߍ߬ ߓߌߦߊߝ߭ߏߜ߭ߌ߫; 28 December 1923 – 19 August 1984) was a Guinean politician. He was Prime Minister from 1972 to 1984 and was briefly acting President in 1984.

tr.name: Veríssimo Correia Seabra
tr.title: Veríssimo Correia Seabra
tr.extract: Veríssimo Correia Seabra (16 Şubat 1947 - 6 Ekim 2004), Gine-Bissaulu asker ve siyasetçidir. Seabra, Afrika ülkesi Gine-Bissau'da 2003 yılında kısa bir süre devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur. Seabra dönemin devlet başkanı Kumba Ialá'ya karşı gerçekleştirdiği askerî darbe ile cuntanın lideri olarak yönetimi 14 Eylül 2003 tarihinde ele almış ve bu görevi 28 Eylül 2003 tarihine kadar sürdürmüştür. Söz konusu tarihte görevi Henrique Rosa önderliğindeki sivil yönetime devrederek makamdan ayrılmıştır. Seabra 6 Ekim 2004 tarihinde ordu içerisinde hak edişlerini almadıkları iddiasıyla isyan çıkartan bir grup asker tarafından rehin alınarak öldürülmüştür.

en.name: Veríssimo Correia Seabra
en.description: Guinea-Biaau general and head of state (1947-2004)
en.title: Veríssimo Correia Seabra
en.extract: General Veríssimo Correia Seabra (16 February 1947 – 6 October 2004) was a Bissau-Guinean general, known for leading a coup that deposed Kumba Ialá on September 14, 2003.

en.name: Alexandre José Maria dos Santos
en.title: Alexandre José Maria dos Santos
en.extract: Alexandre José Maria dos Santos (18 March 1924 – 29 September 2021) was a Mozambican Roman Catholic cardinal. He was the first native cardinal of Mozambique.

en.name: Ruth Williams Khama
en.title: Ruth Williams Khama
en.extract: Ruth Williams Khama, Lady Khama (née Williams; 9 December 1923 – 22 May 2002) was the wife of Botswana's first president Sir Seretse Khama, the Paramount Chief of its Bamangwato tribe. She served as the inaugural First Lady of Botswana from 1966 to 1980.

tr.name: Hamed Bakayoko
tr.title: Hamed Bakayoko
tr.extract: Hamed Bakayoko (d. 8 Mart 1965 - ö. 10 Mart 2021) 8 Temmuz 2020'den 10 Mart 2021 tarihindeki ölümüne kadar Fildişi Sahili Başbakanı olan Fildişili siyasetçi. Daha önce ülkenin Yeni Teknolojiler, Bilgi ve İletişim Bakanı, İçişleri Bakanı ve Savunma Bakanı olarak görev yapmıştı.

en.name: Hamed Bakayoko
en.title: Hamed Bakayoko
en.extract: Hamed Bakayoko (8 March 1965 – 10 March 2021) was an Ivorian politician who served as Prime Minister of Côte d'Ivoire from 8 July 2020 until his death on 10 March 2021. He had previously served as the country's Minister of New Technologies, Information and Communication, Minister of the Interior and Minister of Defense.

tr.name: Bernard Dadié
tr.title: Bernard Dadié
tr.extract: Bernard Binlin Dadié (10 Ocak 1916 – 9 Mart 2019), Fildişi Sahilli yazar, şair ve siyasetçidir.

en.name: Bernard Binlin Dadié
en.title: Bernard Binlin Dadié
en.extract: Bernard Binlin Dadié (10 January 1916 – 9 March 2019) was an Ivorian novelist, playwright, poet, and governmental administrator. Starting in 1957, he held many governmental positions in the Côte d'Ivoire, including Minister of Culture from 1977 to 1986.

en.name: Arthur Percival
en.description: British army officer in the First and Second World Wars
en.title: Arthur Percival
en.extract: Lieutenant-General Arthur Ernest Percival, (26 December 1887 – 31 January 1966) was a British Army officer. He saw service in the First World War and built a successful military career during the interwar period, but is best known for his defeat in the Second World War, when Percival commanded British Commonwealth forces during the Malayan campaign, which culminated in a catastrophic defeat at the Battle of Singapore. Percival's surrender to the invading Imperial Japanese Army, which was the largest of its kind in British military history, significantly undermined Britain's prestige and military position in East Asia. Some historians, such as Sir John Smyth, have argued that under-funding of British Malaya's defences and the inexperienced, under-equipped nature of the Commonwealth forces in Malaya, not Percival's leadership, were ultimately to blame for the defeat.

figures.occupationEn: Catholic priest, Catholic bishop, university teacher

en.name: Prosper Grech
en.title: Prosper Grech
en.extract: Prosper Grech (24 December 1925 – 30 December 2019) was a Maltese Augustinian friar, who co-founded the Patristic Institute Augustinianum in Rome. He was created a cardinal by Pope Benedict XVI on 18 February 2012. He was the second Maltese member of the College of Cardinals, the first since 1843.

tr.name: Muhammed ez-Zanati
tr.title: Muhammed ez-Zanati
tr.extract: Muhammed ez-Zanati (Arapça: الزناتي إمحمد الزناتي Az-Zanati al-Muhammad az-Zanati; 1936/1937 - 26 Mayıs 2025), Genel Halk Kongresi genel sekreteri ve 18 Ocak 1992'den 3 Mart 2008'e kadar Libya devlet başkanı olan Libyalı bir politikacıdır. 1 Mart 2000'de göreve yeniden atandı. Zanati, Huara kabilesinin Kadhadfa kolundandır.

en.name: Muhammad az-Zanati
en.title: Muhammad az-Zanati
en.extract: Muhammad al-Zanati (Arabic: الزناتي إمحمد الزناتي Az-Zanati al-Muhammad az-Zanati; 1936/1937 – 26 May 2025) was a Libyan politician who was the General Secretary of the General People's Congress, and the head of state of Libya from 18 January 1992 until 3 March 2008. He was reappointed on 1 March 2000. He was of the Qadhadhfa branch of the Houara tribe. Az-Zanati died on 26 May 2025, at the age of 88.

tr.name: Abdülfettah Yunus
tr.title: Abdül Fettah Yunus
tr.extract: Abdül Fettah Yunus (Arapça:يونس، عبد الفتاح ) (d.1944 - 28 Temmuz 2011), Libya'da üst düzey bir askeri subaydır. Libya lideri Muammer Kaddafi'nin 1969'dan itibaren sağ koluydu. Şubat ayında olan ayaklanma sonucu 22 Şubat 2011 tarihinde Libya İçişleri Bakanlığı görevinden istifa edip muhaliflerin yanında yer aldı. Bundan sonra muhaliflerin askeri kanadı olan Abdül Fettah Yunus 28 Temmuz 2011'de Bingazi yolunda silahlı saldırıda Kaddafi yandaşları tarafından öldürüldü. Suikastten sonra Yunus'un yerini komutan Süleyman Mahmud devraldı.

en.name: Abdul Fatah Younis
en.title: Abdul Fatah Younis
en.extract: Abdul Fatah Younis Al-Obeidi ( ; Arabic: عبد الفتاح يونس, sometimes transliterated Fattah Younis or Fattah Younes or Fatah Younes; 1944 – 28 July 2011) was a Libyan military officer and politician. He served as Libya's interior minister until his resignation on 22 February 2011 when he defected to the rebel side in the First Libyan Civil War. He was considered a key supporter of Muammar Gaddafi and even No. 2 in the Libyan government. Following his resignation and defection, he urged that the Libyan Army should "join the people and respond to their legitimate demands". In an interview with John Simpson on 25 February, he said he believed Gaddafi would fight to the death, or commit suicide. On 29 July 2011, Younis was reported dead by Libya's National Transitional Council (NTC) in unclear circumstances. According to the NTC's oil minister, Ali Tarhouni, Younis was killed by members of an anti-Gaddafi rebel group and the Libyan government stated that he had been killed by the rebels who suspected he was a double agent.

tr.name: Radola Gajda
tr.title: Radola Gajda
tr.extract: Radola Gajda veya Rudolf Geidl (14 Şubat 1892, Kotor, Avusturya-Macaristan İmparatorluğu – 15 Nisan 1948, Prag, Çekoslovakya) Çek komutan ve siyasetçi.

en.name: Radola Gajda
en.description: Czechoslovak legioneer, Czechoslovak politician and general (1892-1948)
en.title: Radola Gajda
en.extract: Radola Gajda, born as Rudolf Geidl (14 February 1892 – 15 April 1948) was a Czech military commander and politician.

en.name: Gisèle Rabesahala
en.description: Malagasy politician and activist who was the first woman to hold a ministerial position in the government of Madagascar
en.title: Gisèle Rabesahala
en.extract: Marie Gisèle Aimée Rabesahala (7 May 1929 – 27 June 2011) was a Malagasy politician and activist who was the first woman to hold a ministerial position in the government of Madagascar. She entered politics at the age of 17, campaigning on behalf of political prisoners, and becoming Madagascar's first woman municipal councilor, before becoming the first Malagasy woman to establish and lead a political party. She was a committed Marxist and co-founded the communist Congress Party for the Independence of Madagascar, which took power in 1975. In 1977, she became Madagascar's first female minister, responsible for promoting revolutionary art and culture, but lost her job in 1991 when her ministry was abolished in the course of Madagascar's return to multi-party democracy. She remained an active political campaigner and journalist until her death in 2011.

tr.name: Richard Ratsimandrava
tr.title: Richard Ratsimandrava
tr.extract: Albay Richard Ratsimandrava (d. 21 Mart 1931 Antananarivo – ö. 11 Şubat 1975, Antananarivo), Madagaskarlı asker ve siyasetçi. Ratsimandrava, Afrika ada ülkesi Madagaskar'da görev başında öldürülmesinden önce Şubat 1975'te altı gün boyunca devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur.

en.name: Richard Ratsimandrava
en.title: Richard Ratsimandrava
en.extract: Colonel Richard Ratsimandrava (21 March 1931 – 11 February 1975) was a Malagasy politician and soldier who served as the head of state of Madagascar for six days in February 1975 before his assassination in office.

en.name: Kelvin Felix
en.title: Kelvin Felix
en.extract: Kelvin Edward Felix (15 February 1933 – 30 May 2024) was a Dominican Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Castries from 1981 to 2008. He was made a cardinal in 2014, the first from the Caribbean.

en.name: Aleksandrs Čaks
en.title: Aleksandrs Čaks
en.extract: Aleksandrs Čaks [ɑ.lɛk.sɑndrs tʃɑks] (born Aleksandrs Čadarainis; 27 October 1901 – 8 February 1950), was a Latvian poet and writer. Čaks is arguably the first Latvian writer whose works are distinctly urban, compared to the usual depictions of country life or small villages in earlier Latvian literature.

figures.occupationEn: politician, economist, diplomat, head of government

en.name: Zigfrīds Anna Meierovics
en.title: Zigfrīds Anna Meierovics
en.extract: Zigfrīds Anna Meierovics (5 February [O.S. 24 January] 1887, Durbe – 22 August 1925, near Tukums) was a Latvian politician and diplomat who served as the first Foreign Minister of Latvia from its independence until 1924 and again from December of the same year until his death. He also served two terms as the Prime Minister of Latvia from June, 1921 to January, 1923 and from June 1923 to January, 1924. He was one of the founders of the Latvian Farmers' Union, one of Latvia's oldest political parties.

en.name: Pēteris Stučka
en.title: Pēteris Stučka
en.extract: Pēteris Stučka, sometimes Russified to Pyotr Stuchka; (26 July [O.S. 14 July] 1865 – 25 January 1932), was a Latvian jurist and communist politician, leader of the pro-Bolshevik puppet government in Latvia during the 1918–1920 Latvian War of Independence, and later a statesman in the Soviet Union.

image.author: Herman John Schmidt

tr.name: II. George Tupou
tr.title: II. George Tupou
tr.extract: II. George Tupou (Tongaca: Siaosi Tupou II) (d. 18 Haziran 1874 - ö. 5 Nisan 1918), 1893'ten ölümüne kadar Güney Pasifik ülkesi Tonga Krallığı'nın kralıydı. Anne tarafından (ve baba tarafından) büyük büyükbabası olan I. George Tupou, Tonga'nın ilk kralıydı. Ebeveynleri kuzendi ve büyükanne ve büyükbabası erkek ve kız kardeşlerdi. I. George Tupou'nun ölümünden sonra 17 Temmuz 1893'te Nukuʻalofa'da kral olarak taç giydi. 1899 Samoa Antlaşması ile Alman İmparatorluğu Tonga üzerindeki tüm haklardan feragat etti ve 18 Mayıs 1900'de Tonga, Britanya himayesine girdi. II. George Tupou'nun Büyük Britanya ile himaye anlaşması Tonga'yı kendi kendini yönetmeye bıraktı ve yalnızca yerel yönetime danışman olarak bir vali sağladı. Bu sayede ülkenin Yeni Zelanda tarafından ilhak edilmesini engelleyebildi. 1898'de Tahiti Prensesi Edith Marie Pomare Wahine von Eimeo ile evlendi, 1899'da Lavinia Veiongo ile evlendi. Bu evlilikten daha sonra kraliçe olacak olan kızı Sālote dünyaya geldi.

en.name: George Tupou II
en.title: George Tupou II
en.extract: George Tupou II (Tongan: Siaosi Tupou II; 18 June 1874 – 5 April 1918) was the King of Tonga from 18 February 1893 until his death. He was officially crowned at Nukuʻalofa, on 17 March 1893. He was also the 20th Tuʻi Kanokupolu.

image.author: Wahlkampf_JRH_mit_Francisco_do_Amaral_u._Mario_Carrascalao.JPG : Jörg Meier, Watch Indonesia! derivative work: Patrick ( talk )

en.name: Francisco Xavier do Amaral
en.title: Francisco Xavier do Amaral
en.extract: Francisco Xavier do Amaral (3 December 1937 – 6 March 2012) was an East Timorese politician. A founder of the Frente Revolucionária de Timor Leste Independente (Fretilin), Amaral was sworn in as the first President of East Timor when the country, then a Portuguese colony, made a unilateral declaration of independence on 28 November 1975. He was a member of the National Parliament for the Timorese Social Democratic Association from 2001 until his death in 2012. Amaral was also known as "Abo (Grandfather) Xavier", a term of endearment, by East Timorese.

tr.name: Tarafe b. Abd
tr.title: Tarafe b. el-'Abd
tr.extract: Tarafe b. e-'Abd (Arapça: طرفة بن العبد) Câhiliye döneminin en meşhur Arap şairlerinden biridir. Muallaka şairleri arasında sınıflandırılmakta ve yetenekli bir hiciv şairi olarak tanınmaktadır.

en.name: Tarafa
en.title: Tarafa
en.extract: Ṭarafah ibn al-ʿAbd ibn Sufyān (Arabic: طرفة بن العبد بن سفيان; c. 543 – c. 569), commonly known as Tarafa, was a 6th-century pre-Islamic Arabian poet of the tribe of Bakr ibn Wa'il. He is celebrated as one of the seven poets of the Mu'allaqat, the renowned corpus of pre-Islamic odes. Known for his rebellious nature, biting satire, and his early death following a conflict with the Lakhmid king Amr ibn Hind, he was traditionally referred to in Arabic literary tradition as al-Ghulām al-Qatīl ("the murdered youth").

tr.name: Emil Loteanu
tr.title: Emil Loteanu
tr.extract: Emil Loteanu (6 Kasım 1936 - 18 Nisan 2003), Sovyet asıllı Moldovalı film yönetmeni ve senaristtir. 1993 yılında Skorlupa filminde yazar, 1989 yılında Vdvoyom na grani vremeni adlı filmde yönetmenlik yapmıştır.

en.name: Emil Loteanu
en.title: Emil Loteanu
en.extract: Emil Loteanu (6 November 1936 – 18 April 2003) was a Moldovan and Soviet film director born in what is now Republic of Moldova. He moved to Bucharest and Moscow in his early life. His best known films are Lăutarii, Gypsies Are Found Near Heaven, A Hunting Accident and Anna Pavlova.

figures.occupationTr: yazar, şair, baş öğretmen, öykü yazarı
figures.occupationEn: writer, poet, head teacher, short story writer

en.name: Adela Zamudio
aliases: Zamudio Rivero, Paz Juana Plácida Adela Rafaela
en.title: Adela Zamudio
en.extract: Paz Juana Plácida Adela Rafaela Zamudio Rivero (11 October 1854 – 2 June 1928) was a Bolivian poet, feminist, and educator. She is considered the most famous Bolivian poet, and is credited with founding the country's feminist movement. In her writing, she also used the pen-name Soledad. Adela Zamudio's birthday, 11 October, is a national holiday in Bolivia to honor all working women.

en.name: Julio Terrazas Sandoval
en.title: Julio Terrazas Sandoval
en.extract: Julio Terrazas Sandoval (March 7, 1936 – December 9, 2015) was a Cardinal Priest and Archbishop Emeritus of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Santa Cruz de la Sierra in the Roman Catholic Church.

figures.occupationTr: besteci, orkestra şefi, akademisyen, Müzik öğretmeni
figures.occupationEn: composer, conductor, university teacher, music teacher

en.name: Josef Rheinberger
en.title: Josef Rheinberger
en.extract: Josef Gabriel Rheinberger (17 March 1839 – 25 November 1901) was a composer and organist from Liechtenstein, residing in Bavaria for most of his life. As court conductor in Munich, he was responsible for the music in the royal chapel. He is known for sacred music, works for organ and vocal works, such as masses, a Christmas cantata and the motet Abendlied; he also composed two operas and three singspiele, incidental music, secular choral music, two symphonies and other instrumental works, chamber music, and works for organ.

tr.name: José María Castro Madriz
tr.title: José María Castro Madriz
tr.extract: José María Castro Madriz (d. 1 Eylül 1818 – ö. 4 Nisan 1892), Kosta Rikalı entelektüel ve devlet adamı. Castro Madriz, 1847-1849 ve 1866-1868 yılları arasında Kosta Rika başkanı olarak görev yapmıştır. 29 yaşında göreve başlayan Castro Madriz, Kosta Rika tarihinde bu görevi üstlenen en genç kişi oldu. Kırk yılı aşkın süren kamu kariyeri boyunca çok sayıda devlet görevinde bulundu ve Kosta Rika hükûmetinin üç kolunun da başkanlığını yapan ilk kişi oldu. 1847'de dolaylı yoldan başkan seçildi ve 1849'da darbe tehdidi altında istifa edene kadar görev yaptı. 1866'da dolaylı olarak tekrar başkanlık yaptı ve 1868'de askerî baskı altında istifa edene kadar görevde kaldı. İdeolojik olarak liberal olan Castro, Aydınlanma ilkelerine ve basın özgürlüğüne sıkı sıkıya inanıyordu. Kosta Rika'da demokrasiyi güçlendirmek için reformlar yapılması yönünde çaba gösterdi. Aynı zamanda Masonluk üyesiydi. Kariyeri boyunca ölüm cezasının kaldırılmasını, militarizm karşıtlığını ve ücretsiz zorunlu eğitimi savundu. Her iki durumda da Castro, askerî darbeler sonucu başkanlık dönemini tamamlayamadı.

en.name: José María Castro Madriz
en.title: José María Castro Madriz
en.extract: José María Castro Madriz (1 September 1818 – 4 April 1892) was a Costa Rican intellectual and statesman who served as President of Costa Rica from 1847 to 1849 and from 1866 to 1868. Inaugurated at age 29, he was the youngest person to ever serve as President of Costa Rica. Over a public career spanning more than four decades, he held numerous offices of state and became the first person to preside over all three branches of the Costa Rican government. He was indirectly elected president in 1847 and served until 1849 when he resigned under the threat of a coup. He was indirectly president again in 1866 and served 1868 when again he resigned under military pressure. Ideologically a liberal, Castro was a strong believer in the principles of the Enlightenment and in freedom of the press. He pushed for reforms to strengthen democracy in Costa Rica. He was also a member of Freemasonry. Throughout his career, he advocated the abolition of the death penalty, antimilitarism, and free compulsory education.

en.name: Walter Rodney
en.title: Walter Rodney
en.extract: Walter Anthony Rodney (23 March 1942 – 13 June 1980) was a Guyanese historian, political activist and academic. His notable works include How Europe Underdeveloped Africa, first published in 1972. He was assassinated in Georgetown, Guyana, in 1980.

tr.name: Clifford Husbands
tr.title: Clifford Husbands
tr.extract: Clifford Straughn Husbands, (d. 5 Ağustos 1926- ö. 11 Ekim 2017), Barbados'un eski Genel Valisi. Nita Barrow'un ölümünden sonra atandı ve 1996 - 2011 yılları arası Genel Vali olarak görev yaptı. 11 Ekim 2017'de 91 yaşında öldü.

en.name: Clifford Husbands
en.title: Clifford Husbands
en.extract: Clifford Straughn Husbands GCMG KStJ KA QC (5 August 1926 – 11 October 2017) was a Barbadian jurist who served as the 6th Governor-General of Barbados from 1996 to 2011, and was the longest-serving head of state in Barbadian history. Prior to his tenure as governor-general he was a member of the Supreme Court of Judicature.

image.author: Denis Closon / European Communities, 2006 / EC - Audiovisual Service

en.name: Ely Ould Mohamed Vall
en.title: Ely Ould Mohamed Vall
en.extract: Colonel Ely Ould Mohamed Vall (Arabic: إعلي ولد محمد فال I‘lī Wald Muḥammad Fāl; 1953 – 5 May 2017) was a Mauritanian political and military figure. Following a coup d'état in August 2005, he served as the transitional military leader of Mauritania until 19 April 2007, when he relinquished power to an elected government.

tr.name: Laisenia Qarase
tr.title: Laisenia Qarase
tr.extract: Laisenia Qarase (4 Şubat 1941; Vanua Balavu - 21 Nisan 2020; Suva), Fijili siyasetçi.

en.name: Laisenia Qarase
en.title: Laisenia Qarase
en.extract: Laisenia Qarase (pronounced [lai̯seni̯a ŋɡaˈrase]; 4 February 1941 – 21 April 2020) was a Fijian politician. He served as the sixth Prime Minister of Fiji from 2000 to 2006. After the military quashed the coup that led to the removal of Mahendra Chaudhry, Qarase joined the Interim Military Government as a financial adviser on 9 June 2000, until his appointment as Prime Minister on 4 July. He won two parliamentary elections, but a military coup removed him from power on 5 December 2006. He was later imprisoned on corruption charges brought by the military-backed regime. A native of Vanua Balavu Island in the Lau archipelago, he was one of many Lauans to have held top leadership positions in Fiji.

tr.name: Clément Mouamba
tr.title: Clément Mouamba
tr.extract: Clément Mouamba (13 Kasım 1943 - 29 Ekim 2021), Kongolu siyasetçidir. Mouamba, Afrika ülkesi Kongo Cumhuriyeti'nde Nisan 2016 ile 12 Mayıs 2021 tarihleri arasında başbakanlık görevini üstlenmiştir. Mouamba, 1992 ile 1993 yılları arasında devlet başkanı Pascal Lissouba yönetiminde hükûmette Ekonomi Bakanlığı görevini yürütmüştür. 2016 yılında devlet başkanı Denis Sassou Nguesso'ya bir dönem daha seçilme imkanını sunan referandum sonuçları sonucunda Nguesso'nun gerçekleştirilen seçimlerde yeniden devlet başkanı olması ile Mouamba 23 Nisan 2016 tarihinde başbakan olarak atanmıştır. Mouamba 1 Mayıs 2016 tarihi itibarıyla kabinesini oluşturarak Nguesso'nun onayına sunmuştur. Mayıs 2021'de Clément Mouamba ve hükûmeti istifa etti. Mouamba'nın yerine Anatole Collinet Makosso 12 Mayıs 2021 tarihinde başbakan olarak atanmıştır. Mouamba 29 Ekim 2021'de Fransa'nın başkenti Paris'te COVID-19 nedeniyle 77 yaşında öldü.

en.name: Clément Mouamba
en.title: Clément Mouamba
en.extract: Clément Mouamba (13 November 1943 – 29 October 2021) was a Congolese politician who was Prime Minister of the Republic of the Congo from 2016 until 2021. He previously served as Minister of Finance from 1992 to 1993.

tr.name: Ham Lini
tr.title: Ham Lini
tr.extract: Ham Lin̄i Vanuaroroa; (8 Aralık 1951 - 11 Kasım 2025), Vanuatulu siyasetçi.

en.name: Ham Lini
en.title: Ham Lin̄i
en.extract: Ham Lin̄i Vanuaroroa (8 December 1951 – 10 November 2025) was a ni-Vanuatu politician. He was a MP from Pentecost Island in Penama Province. He was Prime Minister of Vanuatu from 11 December 2004 until 22 September 2008. He was the Deputy Prime Minister, having assumed the post on 16 May 2014. Lin̄i was the brother of Walter Lin̄i, one of the founders of the modern Republic of Vanuatu. Ham Lin̄i was the leader of the National United Party (VNUP).

tr.name: René Harris
tr.title: René Harris
tr.extract: René Reynaldo Harris (d. 11 Kasım 1947 - ö. 5 Temmuz 2008) Naurulu siyasetçi. Harris, Büyük Okyanus'ta Mikronezya ada öbeği içerisinde yer alan Nauru'da 1999 ile 2004 yılları arasında olmak üzere, dört farklı dönemde devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur.

en.name: René Harris
en.title: René Harris
en.extract: René Reynaldo Harris (11 November 1947 – 5 July 2008) was a Nauruan politician who served as President of Nauru for four terms between 1999 and 2004. He was a Member of Parliament from 1977 to 2008.

image.terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication

en.name: Cornelius Sim
en.title: Cornelius Sim
en.extract: Cornelius Sim DD (16 September 1951 – 29 May 2021) was a Bruneian prelate of the Catholic Church who served as Vicar Apostolic of Brunei from 2004 until his death. He had previously served as the apostolic prefect of Brunei from 1997 to 2004. Sim was the first graduate of the Franciscan University of Steubenville priestly discernment program to be ordained to the priesthood. Pope Francis raised him to the rank of a cardinal on 28 November 2020, making him the first cardinal from the country, and from the island of Borneo. Sim has been credited as "Brunei's most famous Catholic" and a "towering figure" in the history of Bruneian Christianity.
