en.name: Paulin Soumanou Vieyra
en.title: Paulin Soumanou Vieyra
en.extract: Paulin Soumanou Vieyra (31 January 1925 – 4 November 1987) was a Beninese-Senegalese film director and historian. As he lived in Senegal after the age of 10, he is more associated with that nation. He is known for his 1955 film Afrique-sur-Seine, the first Francophone African film.

en.name: Fernando Amorsolo
en.title: Fernando Amorsolo
en.extract: Fernando Amorsolo y Cueto (May 30, 1892 – April 24, 1972) was a portraitist and painter of rural Philippine landscapes. Nicknamed the "Grand Old Man of Philippine Art," he was the first-ever to be recognized as a National Artist of the Philippines. He was recognized as such for his "pioneering use of impressionistic technique" as well as his skill in the use of lighting and backlighting in his paintings, "significant not only in the development of Philippine art but also in the formation of Filipino notions of self and identity."

figures.occupationTr: oyuncu, komedyen, film yönetmeni, dizi oyuncusu
figures.occupationEn: actor, comedian, film director, television actor

en.name: Eddie Garcia
en.title: Eddie Garcia
en.extract: Eduardo "Eddie" Verchez Garcia (Tagalog: [ˈʔɛdi gaɾˈsɪa]; May 2, 1929 – June 21, 2019), colloquially known as Manoy, was a Filipino actor and filmmaker. Deemed one of the greatest Filipino actors of all time, he was noted for his portrayals of authoritative, antagonistic and comedic characters. He has contributed to nearly 700 film and television productions throughout his career that spanned seventy years. Following the disbandment of Philippine Scouts in 1949, Garcia was convinced by a friend to audition for film roles. He made his feature film debut in Manuel Conde's Siete Infantes de Lara (1950) and later signed an exclusive contract with Sampaguita Pictures where he was often typecast in villainous roles. He gained critical recognition for his roles in Taga sa Bato (1957), Condenado (1958), and Tanikalang Apoy (1959)—winning the FAMAS Award for Best Supporting Actor for three consecutive years.

en.name: Elda Grin
en.title: Elda Grin
en.extract: Elda Ashoti Grigoryan (Armenian: Էլդա Աշոտի Գրիգորյան; 10 March 1928 – 27 October 2016), known also as Elda Grin (Armenian: Էլդա Գրին) was an Armenian writer, psychologist, professor, and legal expert.

en.name: Sipan Shiraz
en.title: Sipan Shiraz
en.extract: Sipan Shiraz (Armenian: Սիփան Շիրազ; June 25, 1967 – April 15, 1997) was an Armenian poet, sculptor and painter.

tr.name: Medea Abrahamyan
tr.title: Medea Abrahamyan
tr.extract: Medea Abrahamyan (Ermenice: Մեդեա Աբրահամյան; 8 Mart 1932, Erivan - 3 Mart 2021, Erivan, Ermenistan), Ermeni çellist ve akademisyendir.

en.name: Medea Abrahamyan
en.title: Medea Abrahamyan
en.extract: Medea Abrahamyan (Armenian: Մեդեա Աբրահամյան; 8 March 1932 – 3 March 2021) was an Armenian cellist, People's Artist of Armenian SSR (1980) and Professor of the Yerevan Komitas State Conservatory (1983).

en.name: Henri François Pittier
en.title: Henri François Pittier
en.extract: Henri François Pittier de Fabrega (August 13, 1857 in Bex, Switzerland – January 27, 1950 in Caracas, Venezuela) was a Swiss geographer and botanist who started Venezuelan National Park history.

en.name: Abdelkrim Ghallab
en.title: Abdelkrim Ghallab
en.extract: Abdelkrim Ghallab (Arabic: عبد الكريم غلاب, romanized: ʿAbd al-Karīm Ghallāb; December 31, 1919, in Fes – August 14, 2017, in El Jadida) was a Moroccan political journalist, cultural commentator, and novelist. He is an important figure both in the literary and political field (editor of the Istiqlal Party daily al-Alam).

en.name: Dambudzo Marechera
en.title: Dambudzo Marechera
en.extract: Dambudzo Marechera (4 June 1952 – 18 August 1987) was a Zimbabwean novelist, short story writer, playwright, and poet. His short career produced a book of stories, two novels (one published posthumously), a book of plays, prose, and poetry, and a collection of poetry (also posthumous). His first book, a fiction collection entitled The House of Hunger (1978), won the Guardian Fiction Prize in 1979. Marechera was best known for his abrasive, heavily detailed, and self-aware writing, which was considered a new frontier in African literature, and his unorthodox behaviour at the universities from which he was expelled despite excelling in his studies.

en.name: Ndabaningi Sithole
en.title: Ndabaningi Sithole
en.extract: Ndabaningi Sithole (21 July 1920 – 12 December 2000) was a Zimbabwean politician and statesman who, in July 1963, founded the Zimbabwe African National Union (ZANU), a militant, nationalist organisation that opposed the government of Rhodesia. He worked as a United Church of Christ in Zimbabwe (UCCZ) minister. He spent 10 years in prison after the government banned ZANU. A rift along tribal lines split ZANU in 1975, and he lost the 1980 elections to Robert Mugabe.

en.name: Fatos Arapi
en.title: Fatos Arapi
en.extract: Fatos Arapi (19 July 1930 – 11 October 2018) was an Albanian poet, short story writer, translator and journalist. Arapi's publications have been highly praised by his readers and his peers and have been awarded various national and international poetry prizes. In 2008 Arapi became the first Albanian poet to win the Golden Wreath Award (Struga Poetry Evenings Award).

figures.occupationTr: senarist, sinema sanatçısı, film yönetmeni, yönetmen

en.name: Xhanfize Keko
en.description: Albanian film director and film editor (1928–2007)
en.title: Xhanfise Keko
en.extract: Xhanfise Keko (27 January 1928 – 22 December 2007), born in Gjirokastër, Albania, was an Albanian film director. Keko was one of the seven founders of New Albania Film Studio (Albanian: Kinostudio Shqipëria e Re) (present-day Albafilm). She was the first female director and directed some 25 different movies between 1952 and 1984 including the 1975 film, Beni Walks by Himself and Tomka and His Friends, both awarded at the Giffoni International Film Festival. Her films were generally targeted toward younger audiences but contemporary critics praise her "sensitive approach to her material, a technical facility outstripping her contemporaries and a highly original voice".

en.name: Ahmed Sofa
en.description: Bangladeshi writer, thinker, novelist, poet, and public intellectual (1943–2001)
en.title: Ahmed Sofa
en.extract: Ahmed Sofa (Bengali: আহমদ ছফা, pronounced [aɦmɔd sɔfa]; 30 June 1943 – 28 July 2001) was a Bangladeshi writer, thinker, novelist, poet, philosopher and public intellectual. Sofa is considered by many, including National Professor Abdur Razzaq and Salimullah Khan, to be the most important Bengali Muslim writer after Mir Mosharraf Hossain and Kazi Nazrul Islam. A writer by occupation, Sofa wrote 18 non-fiction books, 8 novels, 4 collections of poems, 2 collections of short stories, and several books in other genres. Sofa's Bangali Musalmaner Man (The Mind of the Bengali Muslims, 1981) is a highly acclaimed critical survey of the formation of Bengali Muslims' identity, causes of their backwardness, their development as a community, and their intellectual progress. Anisuzzaman and many others consider Sofa's Bangali Musalmaner Man one of the greatest non-fiction books written in the Bengali language.

en.name: Youssouf Ouédraogo
en.title: Youssouf Ouédraogo
en.extract: Youssouf Ouédraogo (25 December 1952 – 18 November 2017) was a Burkinabé politician. In 1992 he became the first prime minister of Burkina Faso since 1983, serving from 16 June 1992 to 22 March 1994. Ouédraogo, a member of the ruling Congress for Democracy and Progress (CDP), later served as Minister of State for Foreign Affairs from January 1999 to June 2007.

image.title: Photographie Ouezzin Coulibaly.jpg
image.terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
image.author: Assemblée nationale

en.name: Daniel Ouezzin Coulibaly
en.title: Daniel Ouezzin Coulibaly
en.extract: Daniel Ouezzin Coulibaly (1 July 1909 – 7 September 1958) was the president of the governing council of the French colony of Upper Volta, today's Burkina Faso, from 17 May 1957 until his death on 7 September 1958 in Paris, France. A native of Pouy, today in Banwa Province, Coulibaly also served in the French national assembly from 1946 to 1951 and from 1956 to 1958, as well as in the French senate from 1953 to 1956. His wife was Célestine Ouezzin Coulibaly (1914–1997).

en.name: Joseph Ki-Zerbo
en.title: Joseph Ki-Zerbo
en.extract: Joseph Ki-Zerbo (June 21, 1922 – December 4, 2006, Burkina Faso) was a Burkinabé historian, politician and writer. He is recognized as one of Africa's foremost thinkers. From 1972 to 1978 he was a professor of African History at the University of Ouagadougou. In 1983, he was forced into exile, only being able to return in 1992. Ki-Zerbo founded the Party for Democracy and Progress / Socialist Party. He was its chairman until 2005, and represented it in the Burkina Faso parliament until his death in 2006. A socialist and an advocate of African independence and unity, Ki-Zerbo was also a vocal opponent of Thomas Sankara's revolutionary government.

image.title: Bundesarchiv B 145 Bild-F023488-0008, Bonn, Lücke empfängt Kardinal Zoungrana.jpg
image.author: Engelbert Reineke

en.name: Paul Zoungrana
en.title: Paul Zoungrana
en.extract: Paul Zoungrana, MAfr (3 September 1917 – 4 June 2000) was a Burkinabé Cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as Archbishop of Ouagadougou from 1960 to 1995, and was elevated to the cardinalate in 1965.

tr.name: Mihail Ageyev
tr.title: Mihail Ageyev
tr.extract: Mihail Ageyev (Mark Lazareviç Levi), (d. 8 Ağustos 1898, Moskova - ö. 5 Ağustos 1973, Erivan) kimliği pek bilinmeyen, 20. yüzyılın ilk yarısında yaşayan Rus bir yazarın takma adıdır. Bu yazarın gerçek adı Marc Leviydi. Bolşeviklerin zaferinden sonra Mark Levi, Fransa'ya gitti. Orada yazdığı Kokain Romanı adlı en bilinen eseri, Levi'nin ölümünden sonra bulunup yayımlanmıştır. Bazı Rus Edebiyati uzmanları, Kokain Romanı'nın, takma adınını kullanan Vladimir Nabokov tarafından yazıldığını tahmin ediyorlar. Her nasılsa, Levi'nin hayatı karanlık ve esrarengiz: bu adam hakkında hemen hiçbir şey bilinmiyor. 1898 ile 1973 arasında tanımlanan hayatı sınırları bile, son derece kuşkulu: bazı uzmanların iddialarına göre Levi, Rusya'ya dönüp Stalin tasfiyeleri nedeniyle öldü.

en.name: M. Ageyev
en.title: M. Ageyev
en.extract: M. Ageyev (Russian: М. Агеев) was the pen name of the writer of the Russian Novel with Cocaine. He is believed to be Mark Lazarevich Levi (Russian: Марк Ла́заревич Ле́ви; August 8, 1898 – August 5, 1973).

en.name: Slavko Avsenik
en.title: Slavko Avsenik
en.extract: Slavko Avsenik (November 26, 1929 – July 2, 2015) was a Slovene composer and musician. Beginning in 1953 with the formation of the Avsenik Brothers Ensemble, Avsenik produced more than 1,000 songs and garnered success both in Slovenia and in other parts of Europe and America, and is viewed as a Slovenian cultural icon.

tr.name: Eugène Camara
tr.title: Eugène Camara
tr.extract: Eugène Camara (21 Ocak 1942 - 22 Kasım 2019 ), Gineli eski siyasetçi ve başbakan.

en.name: Eugène Camara
en.title: Eugène Camara
en.extract: Eugène Camara (21 January 1942 – 22 November 2019) was a politician from Guinea who was briefly Prime Minister of Guinea in February 2007.

tr.name: II. Cabir El-Sabah
tr.title: II. Cabir es-Sabah
tr.extract: II. Cabir el-Mübarek Es-Sabah (1860 – 5 Şubat 1917) (Arapça: الشيخ جابر المبارك الصباح), Kuveyt'in sekizinci şeyhi olarak hizmet verdi. Şeyh Cabir Al-Sabah ailesinin Al-Cabir dallının atasıdır ve önceki Şeyh Mübarek Al-Sabah'ın büyük evladıdır. 28 Kasım 1915 – 5 Şubat 1917 yılları arası Şeyh olmuştur ve ölümü sonrası kardeşi Salim el-Mübarek es-Sabah Şeyh olarak yerine geçmiştir.

en.name: Jaber II Al-Sabah
en.title: Jaber II Al-Sabah
en.extract: Jaber II Al-Mubarak Al-Sabah, (1860 – 5 February 1917), was the eighth ruler of the Sheikhdom of Kuwait from the Al-Sabah dynasty. He was the eldest son of Mubarak Al-Sabah and is the ancestor of the Al-Jaber branch of the Al-Sabah family. He ruled the country from 28 November 1915 to his death on 5 February 1917 and was succeeded by his brother, Salim Al-Mubarak Al-Sabah. Although his reign was very short, Jaber is known for economic reforms he initiated.

en.name: Noémia de Sousa
aliases: Carolina Noémia Abranches de Sousa Soares
en.title: Noémia de Sousa
en.extract: Carolina Noémia Abranches de Sousa Soares, known as Noémia de Sousa (20 September 1926 – 4 December 2002), was a poet from Mozambique who wrote in the Portuguese language. She was also known as Vera Micaia. She was of mixed Portuguese and Bantu descent. De Sousa's poetry and involvement in Moçambicanidade was a large part of the anti-colonial literary movement of Mozambique.

tr.name: Kizito Mihigo
tr.title: Kizito Mihigo
tr.extract: Kizito Mihigo (25 Temmuz 1981 - 17 Şubat 2020), Ruandalı gospel şarkıcısı, söz yazarı, orgcu ve besteci, televizyon sunucusu, soykırım mağduru insan hakları aktivistidir.

en.name: Kizito Mihigo
en.title: Kizito Mihigo
en.extract: Kizito Mihigo (25 July 1981 – 17 February 2020) was a Rwandan gospel singer, songwriter, organist, composer of sacred music, television presenter, genocide survivor, peace maker and peace and reconciliation activist. Kizito was an iconic activist who dedicated his life to healing the souls of his fellow genocide survivors and rebuilding unity and reconciliation in Rwanda. According to Kisito's words, published on Kizitomihigo.com, he claimed, "The objective of my works is to console and strengthen the wounded hearts, singing peace and forgiveness." His ultimate performance in healing and Peacebuilding started in 2010 when he created the Kizito Mihigo Peace Foundation, a non-profit organization devoted to his cause. In April 2014, after releasing a critical song challenging the official narrative of the Rwandan genocide, Mihigo was arrested and charged with planning to oust the government. In February 2015, he was sentenced to 10 years of imprisonment after being convicted of conspiracy against the government of President Paul Kagame.

tr.name: Ebu Anas El-Libi
tr.title: Ebu Enes el-Libi
tr.extract: Nezih Abdülhamid Nebih el-Rukay (Arapça: أبو أنس الليبي; 30 Mart ya da 14 Mayıs 1964, Tripoli - 2 Ocak 2015) veya bilinen adıyla Ebu Enes el-Libi, Libya kökenli olup radikal İslamcı örgüt el-Kaide'nin üst düzey sorumlularındandı. Uzun yıllar boyu aranan el-Libi, Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nin Kenya ve Tanzanya'daki temsilciliklerine yapılan bombalı saldırılarla ilgili olarak suçlanıyordu. 1998'de yapılan saldırılarda aralarında Amerikalıların da bulunduğu 224 kişi yaşamını yitirmişti. 50 yaşındaki Hepatit C hastası El Libi, 2013 yılında Libya'da yapılan operasyonla yakalandıktan sonra Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'ne götürülmüştü. El-Libi Tripoli, Libya doğumlu evli dört çocuğu bulunmaktaydı. El-Kaide'nin üst düzey sorumlularından olduğu öne sürülen, Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nin Afrika'daki iki temsilciliğine bombalı eylem yapmakla suçlanan Ebu Enes el-Libi geçirdiği karaciğer ameliyatı sonrası 2 Ocak 2015'te 50 yaşında öldü.

en.name: Anas al-Liby
en.title: Abu Anas al-Libi
en.extract: Nazih Abdul-Hamed Nabih al-Ruqai'i, known by the alias Abu Anas al-Libi ( AH-boo AH-nahs ahl LEE-bee; Arabic: ابو أنس الليبي Libyan pronunciation: [ˈæbu ˈʔænæs əlˈliːbi]; 1964 – 2 January 2015), was a Libyan under indictment in the United States for his part in the 1998 United States embassy bombings. He worked as a computer specialist for al-Qaeda. He was an ethnic Libyan, born in Tripoli. His aliases in the indictment are Nazih al Raghie and Anas al Sebai. In the FBI and United States State Department wanted posters, another variant of his name is transliterated Nazih Abdul Hamed Al-Raghie. The indictment accused al-Libi of surveillance of potential British, French, and Israeli targets in Nairobi, in addition to the American embassy in that city, as part of a conspiracy by al-Qaeda and Egyptian Islamic Jihad.

en.name: Yelena Mazanik
en.description: Partisan and Hero of the Soviet Union who assassinated Wilhelm Kube (1914–1996)
en.title: Yelena Mazanik
en.extract: Yelena Grigoryevna Mazanik (Russian: Еле́на Григо́рьевна Маза́ник, Belarusian: Але́на Рыго́раўна Маза́нік, romanized: Aliena Ryhoraǔna Mazanik; 2 March 1914 – 7 April 1996) was a Soviet Belarusian partisan responsible for the assassination of Wilhelm Kube, General-Kommissar of Nazi-occupied Belarus, whom she killed by placing a small time-bomb under his bed while working for him as a housemaid. For assassinating him she and her co-conspirators were awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union on 29 October 1943 by decree of the Supreme Soviet. Her post-war life was spent as a librarian.

en.name: Vernon Shaw
en.title: Vernon Shaw
en.extract: Vernon Lorden Shaw (13 May 1930 – 2 December 2013) was the fifth President of Dominica, in office from 1998 to 2003. Shaw was an alumnus of the Dominica Grammar School and Trinity College, Oxford. He was a career civil servant, rising to the post of Cabinet Secretary in 1977, and retiring in 1990. He became resident tutor of the University of the West Indies in 1991. Shaw was elected to a five-year term as president by the House of Assembly on 2 October 1998, as the candidate of the United Workers' Party (UWP). The secret ballot, party-line vote was 18–13. He took office on October 6, 1998, following the expiration of President Crispin Sorhaindo's single five-year term. Shaw left office on 1 October 2003, and was succeeded by Nicholas Liverpool. He died on 2 December 2013 at the age of 83.

en.name: Juris Upatnieks
en.description: Latvian-American physicist and inventor (born 1936), one of the inventors of the hologram
en.title: Juris Upatnieks
en.extract: Juris Upatnieks (May 7, 1936 – May 17, 2026) was a Latvian-American physicist and inventor, and pioneer in the field of holography. He was nominated for the 1969 Nobel Prize in Physics alongside Emmett Leith but did not win.

tr.name: Veerasamy Ringadoo
tr.title: Veerasamy Ringadoo
tr.extract: Sir Veerasamy Ringadoo (Tamilce: வீரசாமி ரிங்காடு) (20 Ekim 1920, Port Louis - 9 Eylül 2000, Port Louis), Mauritiuslu siyasetçi. Ringadoo, Afrika ada ülkesi Mauritius'un bağımsızlığının ardından ilk devlet başkanı olarak makama çıkmıştır. Tamil etnik grubuna mensup bir Hint olan Veerasamy Ringadoo, 17 Ocak 1986 ile 12 Mart 1992 yılları arasında ülkesinin İngiliz Milletler Topluluğu üyesi olduğu dönemde kraliçe II. Elizabeth'i temsilen Mauritius genel valisi görevini yürütmüştür. 12 Mart 1992 tarihinde Mauritius'ta yapılan anayasa değişikliği ile cumhuriyete geçilmesi ile birlikte yeni Mauritius Cumhuriyeti'nin ilk cumhurbaşkanı olarak göreve başlamış, bu görevi de ülkede yapılan ilk demokratik seçimler sonucunda 30 Haziran 1992 tarihinde Cassam Uteem'e devretmiştir.

en.name: Veerasamy Ringadoo
en.title: Veerasamy Ringadoo
en.extract: Sir Veerasamy Ringadoo, GCMG, GCSK, QC, (20 October 1920 – 9 September 2000) was a Mauritian politician, minister, the sixth and last governor-general of Mauritius from 1986 to 1992, and then the first president of Mauritius from March to June 1992.

en.name: Basilio do Nascimento
en.description: Roman Catholic bishop of Baucau, East Timor
en.title: Basílio do Nascimento
en.extract: Basílio do Nascimento Martins (14 June 1950 – 30 October 2021) was the East Timorese Roman Catholic Bishop of Baucau. He was born in Suai, then Portuguese Timor. He later moved to Portugal, where he was ordained as a priest in Évora, in 1977. He worked for 20 years in Portugal and France before returning home in 1994, which was at the time under Indonesian occupation. He became apostolic administrator of the new Diocese of Baucau on 30 November 1996 and titular bishop on 6 January 1997. When Carlos Filipe Ximenes Belo retired, Nascimento became apostolic administrator of the Diocese of Dili, until the new Bishop of Dili, Alberto Ricardo da Silva, was installed on 6 March 2004. Nascimento then became the Bishop of Baucau. In October 1999, the President of the National Council of Timorese Resistance Xanana Gusmão thanked Bishop Nascimento for the support of the Church in the struggle for independence.

tr.name: Sabat İslambouli
tr.title: Sabat İslambouli
tr.extract: Sabat M. İslambuli (1867) – 1941), Kürtçe (Spat Îslambolî) Suriyeli ilk Kürt kadın doktorlardan biriydi. Kürt - Yahudi bir ailenin çocuğu olarak dünyaya geldi. Adının yazılışında farklılıklar var ve aynı zamanda Sabat Islambooly, Tabat Islambouly, Tabat Istanbuli, Thabat Islambooly ve daha fazlası olarak biliniyor.

en.name: Sabat Islambouli
en.description: First licensed female doctor in Syria
en.title: Sabat Islambouli
en.extract: Sabat M. Islambouli (1867–1941) was a physician, of Kurdish Jewish heritage. Born in Ottoman Syria, she is the first known female physician from Syria under Ottoman rule. She has had variations of the spelling of her name, and is also known as Sabat Islambooly, Tabat Islambouly, Tabat Istanbuli, Thabat Islambooly, and more.

tr.name: Conceição Lima
tr.title: Conceição Lima
tr.extract: Maria da Conceição de Deus Lima (d. 8 Aralık 1961 –ö. 15 Mayıs 2026), São Tomé ve Príncipe edebiyatının en güçlü çağdaş seslerinden birisi olan Dünya'ca ünlü şair ve gazeteci.

en.name: Conceição Lima
aliases: Maria da Conceição de Deus Lima
en.title: Conceição Lima
en.extract: Maria da Conceição de Deus Lima (December 8, 1961 – May 15, 2026) was a São Toméan poet.

en.name: Ivan Bodiul
en.title: Ivan Bodiul
en.extract: Ivan Ivanovich Bodiul (Russian: Иван Иванович Бодюл; 3 January 1918 [O.S. 21 December 1917] – 27 January 2013) was a Soviet and Moldovan politician prominent in the Moldavian SSR, particularly during the Brezhnev era. He was primarily responsible for the controversial decision to amend the Anthem of the Moldavian Soviet Socialist Republic in 1980. It was the best anthem of the Soviet Republics (according to the 1950 musical competition).

figures.occupationTr: siyasetçi, şarkıcı, opera sanatçısı, müzik öğretmeni
figures.occupationEn: politician, singer, opera singer, music educator

en.name: Maria Bieșu
en.title: Maria Bieșu
en.extract: Maria Bieșu (3 August 1935 – 16 May 2012) was a Moldovan opera singer. Debuting in 1961, she eventually went on to become the lead vocalist of the Moldova National Opera Ballet. Her artistic excellence brought her international recognition and invitations to sing in other countries, like Japan and Italy, where she performed at the Milan Opera from 1965 to 1967.

tr.name: Ivan Calin
tr.title: Ivan Calin
tr.extract: Ivan Calin (Rusça: Иван Петрович Калин) (d. 10 Mart 1935 - ö. 2 Ocak 2012), Sovyet ve Moldovalı bir agronomist-bilgin, siyaset bilimci, diplomat ve politikacıydı . Calin, Moldova SSC'de 1985-1990 yılları arasında başbakanlık görevi gören bakanlar kurulu başkanı görevini üstlenmiştir.

en.name: Ivan Calin
en.title: Ivan Calin
en.extract: Ivan Calin (10 March 1935 – 2 January 2012) was a Soviet and Moldovan agronomist-scholar, political scientist, diplomat and politician.

en.name: Eugen Gomringer
en.title: Eugen Gomringer
en.extract: Eugen Gomringer (20 January 1925 – 21 August 2025) was a Bolivian-born Swiss concrete poet. He was head of the Institut für Konstruktive Kunst und Konkrete Poesie (IKKP) in Rehau, Germany. Between 1977 and 1990, he was a professor at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf, the Arts Academy of the city of Düsseldorf. Gomringer wrote in German, Spanish, French, and English.

en.name: Joan Martí i Alanis
en.title: Joan Martí i Alanis
en.extract: Joan Martí i Alanis (29 November 1928 – 11 October 2009) was a Spanish Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Urgell and ex officio episcopal co-Prince of Andorra from 1971 to 2003. He was a co-signatory, along with François Mitterrand, of Andorra's new constitution in 1993. In 1979, he founded Caritas Andorra.

tr.name: Jurelang Zedkaia
tr.title: Jurelang Zedkaia
tr.extract: Jurelang Zedkaia (d. 13 Temmuz 1950-ö. 7 Ekim 2015), Marshall Adaları eski devlet başkanı ve politikacı. Selefi Litokwa Tomeing'in devrilmesinden sonra 26 Ekim 2009 tarihinde Marshall Adaları'nın 5. Cumhurbaşkanı seçildi. 10 Ocak 2012'de seçimleri kaybederek görevi sona erdi. Jurelang Zedkaia Ocak 2008 yılında yasama Başkanı olmadan önce Nitijela'nın yardımcısı ve sözcüsü olmuştur.

en.name: Jurelang Zedkaia
en.title: Jurelang Zedkaia
en.extract: Iroijlaplap Jurelang Zedkaia (13 July 1950 – 7 October 2015) was a Marshallese politician and Iroijlaplap. He served as the President of the Marshall Islands from 2009 to 2012. He was elected as the country's 5th head of state on October 26, 2009, following the ouster of his predecessor, Litokwa Tomeing, in the country's first successful vote of no confidence.

en.name: Dimi Mint Abba
en.title: Dimi Mint Abba
en.extract: Dimi Mint Abba (Arabic: ديمي منت آبا‎; 25 December 1958 – June 2011) was one of Mauritania's most famous musicians. She was born Loula Bint Siddaty Ould Abba in Tidjikja in Mauritania, 1958, into a low-caste ("iggawin") family specializing in the griot tradition.

tr.name: Gulnazar Keldi
tr.title: Gulnazar Keldi
tr.extract: Gulnazar Keldi (Tacikçe:Гулназар Келдӣ; 20 Eylül 1945, Dardar – 13 Ağustos 2020, Duşanbe), Tacik şair ve yayıncı.

en.name: Gulnazar Keldi
en.title: Gulnazar Keldi
en.extract: Gulnazar Keldi (Tajik: Гулназар Келдӣ; 20 September 1945 – 13 August 2020) was a Tajikistani poet from Dardar and editor of the publication Adabiyet va sanat (Literature and Art). Keldi wrote the lyrics of "Surudi Milli", the national anthem of Tajikistan.

tr.name: Gulmurad Halimov
tr.title: Gulmurad Halimov
tr.extract: Gulmurad Salimoviç Halimov (Tacikçe: Гулмурод Салимович Ҳалимов; 14 Mayıs 1975, Varzob - 8 Eylül 2017), Tacik İslamcı askerî komutan. Tacikistan İçişleri Bakanlığına bağlı polis özel kuvvetleri OMON'da yarbay rütbesiyle görevliyken, 2015 yılında Irak ve Şam İslam Devleti'ne katıldı. Eylül 2016'da örgütün Savaş Bakanı olarak atandığı açıklandı.

en.name: Gulmurod Khalimov
en.title: Gulmurod Khalimov
en.extract: Gulmurod Salimovich Khalimov (Tajik: Гулмурод Салимович Ҳалимов, Russian: Гулмурод Салимович Халимов) (14 May 1975 – 8 September 2017) was a Tajik and Islamist military commander. He was a lieutenant-colonel and commander of the police special forces of the Interior Ministry of Tajikistan until 2015, when he defected to the Islamic State. In September 2016, he was reported to have been appointed as the minister of war of IS in place of Abu Omar al-Shishani; his appointment had not been announced by IS for fears that he might be targeted in airstrikes by the anti-IS coalition. On 8 September 2017, Khalimov was allegedly killed during a Russian airstrike near Deir ez-Zor, Syria. However, the Tajik government, United Nations, and the United States believed that he was still alive by 2019, though his exact fate remained disputed. By 2020, Islamist militants claimed he had died at some point; this source was considered unreliable by the Tajik government. Regardless, the United States had removed Khalimov from their Rewards for Justice Program by 2021.

tr.name: Alfred Raoul
tr.title: Alfred Raoul
tr.extract: Alfred Raoul (4 Aralık 1938 – 16 Temmuz 1999), Kongolu siyasetçi. Raoul, Afrika ülkesi Kongo Cumhuriyeti'nde 1968 yılında kısa bir süre devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur. Dönemin devlet başkanı Alphonse Massemba-Débat'eye karşı 4 Eylül 1968 tarihinde gerçekleştirilen darbeden kısa bir süre önce kurulan geçici hükûmetin başbakanı olarak 4 Ağustos 1968'de başbakanlık görevine atanan Raoul, gerçekleştirilen darbe neticesinde 5 Eylül 1968 tarihinden itibaren oluşturulan Conseil national de la révolution (Türkçe:Ulusal Devrim Konseyi) komitesinin başı olarak devlet başkanlığı görevlerini geçici olarak üstlenmiş ve bu görevini de ardılı Marien Ngouabi devlet başkanlığına getirildiği 31 Aralık 1968 tarihine kadar sürdürmüştür. Devlet başkanlığını Ngouabi devrettikten sonra başbakanlık makamına geri dönen Raoul, bu görevi başbakanlık makamının anayasa değişikliği sonrasında kaldırıldığı 30 Aralık 1969 tarihine kadar sürdürmüştür.

en.name: Alfred Raoul
en.title: Alfred Raoul
en.extract: Alfred Raoul (15 December 1938 – 16 July 1999) was President of the Republic of the Congo from 5 September 1968 to 1 January 1969, and the Prime Minister of the Republic of the Congo from August 1968 to December 1969. He was Vice President of the People's Republic of Congo from January 1970 to December 1971. He was married to Émilienne Raoul.

tr.name: Lagumot Harris
tr.title: Lagumot Harris
tr.extract: Lagumot Gagiemem Nimidere Harris (d. 28 Aralık 1938 - ö. 8 Eylül 1999), Naurulu din görevlisi ve siyasetçi. Harris, Büyük Okyanus'ta Mikronezya ada öbeği içerisinde yer alan Nauru'da 1978'de kısa bir dönem ve 1995-1996 yılları arasında olmak üzere iki farklı dönemde devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur. Harris ilk olarak Nauruan CDF'nin (Nauru Cemaat Kilisesi) papazı olarak çalıştı . Bununla birlikte, bundan uzaklaştı ve 1976'da Boe'de Bağımsızlık Kilisesi'ni kurdu, bu da başlangıçta birçok takipçi kazandı. 1978'de parlamento seçilen başkan oldu. Diğer Nauruan siyasetçilerinden farklı olarak Harris, entrika ve işleri olmayan büyük ölçüde saygı duyulan bir kişiydi. Air Nauru'nun Avustralya'daki Kasım 1996'da havayolunun başkanının kötü davranış nedeniyle görevden alındığı "uçuş yasağı" nda Harris, başkanlık görevini güvenilir olmayan bir oylamadan sonra Bernard Dowiyogo'ya teslim etmek zorunda kaldı. Dowiyogo daha sonra Air Nauru'nun yeni başkanı olarak Avustralya Ken McDonald'yı atadı. Harris daha önce eyalet ziyareti sırasında Manila'yı ziyaret etti.

en.name: Lagumot Harris
en.title: Lagumot Harris
en.extract: Lagumot Gagiemem Nimidere Harris (23 December 1938 – 8 September 1999) was a political figure from the Pacific nation of the Republic of Nauru, and served as its President. He was a cousin of René Harris, who also became Nauru president subsequently.

tr.name: Kinza Clodumar
tr.title: Kinza Clodumar
tr.extract: Kinza Clodumar (d. 8 Şubat 1945 - ö. 3 Aralık 2021), Naurulu siyasetçi. Clodumar, Büyük Okyanus'ta Mikronezya ada öbeği içerisinde yer alan Nauru'da 1997-1998 yılları arasında devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur. İlk olarak 1977 yılında meclise seçilen Clodumar, ilerleyen süreçte farklı dönemlerde Maliye Bakanlığı görevlerini üstlendi. 1997 yılında yapılan seçimlerde rakibi Ruben Kun'u bir oy farkla geçerek makama geldi. 13 Şubat 1997 tarihinde yemin ederek başladığı görevi kendisine karşı güvenoylaması yapıldığı ve kaybettiği 18 Haziran 1998 tarihine kadar sürdürmüştür. Söz konusu tarihte görevi ardılı olarak dönemin Eğitim Bakanı Bernard Dowiyogo'ya bırakarak makamdan ayrılmıştır. İlerleyen yıllarda yine farklı kabinelerde Maliye Bakanı olarak görev almıştır. 4 Eylül 2004 yılında Air Nauru genel müdürü olarak görevinden 'yolsuzluk' iddiasıyla alınmasının ardından meclis üyeliği de sonlandırıldı. 3 Aralık 2021 tarihinde 76 yaşında hayatını kaybetti.

en.name: Kinza Clodumar
en.title: Kinza Clodumar
en.extract: Kinza Godfrey Clodumar (8 February 1945 – 29 November 2021) was a Nauruan politician who served as President of Nauru from 1997 to 1998.

tr.name: Derog Gioura
tr.title: Derog Gioura
tr.extract: Derog Gioura (d. 1 Eylül 1932 - ö. 25 Eylül 2008), Naurulu siyasetçi. Gioura, Büyük Okyanus'ta Mikronezya ada öbeği içerisinde yer alan Nauru'da 2003 yılında kısa bir süre geçici olarak devlet başkanlığı makamında bulunmuştur. Selefi Bernard Dowiyogo 10 Mart 2003 hayatını kaybetmesinin ardından, Nauru parlamentosu tarafından geçici olarak makama atandı. Kısa bir süre sonra parlamento seçimlerinde yeniden parlamentoya seçilen Gioura, Ludwig Scotty ve Kinza Clodumar ile birlikte bir sonraki devlet başkanlığı seçimlerine adaylığını açıkladı. Gioura, 29 Mayıs 2003 tarihinde kalp krizi geçirmesi neticesinde adaylıktan çekildiğini açıkladı. Melbourne'deki bir hastaneye kaldırılarak tedavi altına alındı. Aynı gün parlamento Ludwig Scotty'yi yeni başkan olarak seçti. Hastalığından kurtulduktan sonra Nauru'ya döndü ve Scotty'yi güvensizlik oyu ile devirmek için yaptığı başarılı girişimde René Harris'i destekledi ve kabinesinde Kadın ve Aile Bakanı oldu. Harris 22 Haziran 2004 güvenoylamasını kayberedek devrilmişti, Gioura bakan olarak görevden alındı, ancak bir parlamenter olarak kaldı.

en.name: Derog Gioura
en.title: Derog Gioura
en.extract: Derog Gioura (1 September 1932 – 25 September 2008) was a Nauruan political figure. He was President of the Republic of Nauru (acting) in 2003.

tr.name: Kennan Adeang
tr.title: Kennan Adeang
tr.extract: Kennan Ranibok Adeang (d. 23 Aralık 1942 - ö. 26 Aralık 2011 ), Naurulu siyasetçi. Adeang, Büyük Okyanus'ta Mikronezya ada öbeği içerisinde yer alan Nauru'da her üçü de kısa dönem olmak üzere 1986'da iki farklı dönem, 1996 yılında da bir dönem olmak üzere toplam üç farklı dönemde devlet başkanlığı görevini yürüttü. İlk başkanlık görevini 17 Eylül 1986 ile 1 Ekim 1986 yılları arasında gerçekleştiren Adeang, güvenoylamasında yeterli oyu alamamasının ardından görevinden ayrılmıştır. Aynı yılın Aralık ayında bir kez daha makama gelen Adeang, bir kez daha güven oyu alamadığı için makamdan 10 gün gibi kısa bir sürede ayrılmıştır. Adeang son olarak 26 Kasım 1996 ile 19 Aralık 1996 tarihleri arasında makama gelmiş, üçüncü süreci de güvenoylamasında gerekli güveni alamamasının ardından sona ermiştir. Adeang, 26 Aralık 2011 tarihinde ölmüştür. Adeang'ın oğlu David Adeang, 30 Ekim 2023'te Nauru devlet başkanlığı görevini üstlenmiştir.

en.name: Kennan Adeang
en.title: Kennan Adeang
en.extract: Kennan Ranibok Adeang (23 December 1942 – 26 December 2011) was a Nauruan politician who served as President of Nauru for three separate and brief periods during the late 20th century. Born in Nauru, and educated in Australia, including at the Australian School of Pacific Administration, Adeang was first elected to the Parliament of Nauru in 1971, representing the seat of Ubenide, and became a noted opponent of Hammer DeRoburt, the country's first president. He first became president in 1986, serving two short terms at the end of that year, one lasting 15 days and the other only 11 days. In the following year, 1987, Adeang was involved in the establishment of the Democratic Party of Nauru, one of the first political parties in Nauru. He again served as president in late 1996, but lost power in a motion of no confidence after only 24 days in office. Adeang was active in parliament until 2000, serving at various times in the Cabinet, and also as Speaker from February 1997 to December 1998.

tr.name: Milton Margai
tr.title: Milton Margai
tr.extract: Sir Milton Augustus Strieby Margai (7 Aralık 1895 - 28 Nisan 1964), Sierra Leoneli siyasetçi. Margai, Afrika ülkesi Sierra Leone'nin Sierra Leone Kolonisi ve Protektorası olarak Britanya sömürgesi olduğu süreçte başladığı ve ülkenin bağımsızlığını ilan etmesinin ardından bu görevdeki ilk kişi olarak başbakanlık makamında bulunmuştur. 1958'de Başbakan oldu. 1959'da II. Elizabeth kendisine 'Sir' unvanı vererek soylu kategorisine yükseltti. Ülkesinin 27 Nisan 1961'de bağımsızlığı ilan etmesinin ardından otomatik olarak ülkenin ilk başbakanı olarak görevini yürüttü. 1962'de düzenlenen seçimleri kazanmayı başardı. Margai, 1964'te Freetown'da hayatını kaybetmesinin ardından yerine kardeşi Albert Margai geçti.

en.name: Milton Augustus Strieby Margai
en.title: Milton Margai
en.extract: Sir Milton Augustus Strieby Margai (7 December 1895 – 28 April 1964) was a Sierra Leonean physician and politician who served as the country's head of government from 1954 until his death in 1964. He was titled chief minister from 1954 to 1960, and then prime minister from 1961 onwards. Margai studied medicine in England, and upon returning to his homeland became a prominent public health campaigner. He entered politics as the founder and inaugural leader of the Sierra Leone People's Party. Margai oversaw Sierra Leone's transition to independence, which occurred in 1961. He died in office aged 68, and was succeeded as prime minister by his brother Albert. Margai enjoyed the support of Sierra Leoneans across classes, who respected his moderate style, friendly demeanor, and political savvy.

en.name: Bolkiah of Brunei
en.title: Bolkiah
en.extract: Bolkiah ibni Sulaiman (Jawi: بلقية ابن سليمان; died 17 July 1524) or commonly known as Nakhoda Ragam (Jawi: ناخودا راڬم), was the sixth sultan of Brunei from 1485 until his death in 1524, he ascended the throne upon the abdication of his father, Sultan Sulaiman. His reign was known as the "Golden Age of Brunei" due to its dominance throughout Borneo and the southern Philippines. He is considered the first sultan to have used cannons, as the Sultan paid forty Javanese blacksmiths to teach metal casting in Brunei, possibly introducing cannon casting, introducing cannon technology to Brunei. Bolkiah was mentioned in the Batu Tarsilah, a 19th-century Bruneian stone tablet which describes the genealogy of the Sultans of Brunei. He was also mentioned in the Silsilah Raja-Raja Berunai, a 19th-century manuscript which also describes the same genealogy. The Spaniards refer to him as Sultan Salan in the Boxer Codex, a 16th-century Spanish manuscript.
